नेविगेटिंग ग्लोबल अनसर्टेनटीज एंड स्ट्रेंथेनिंग पार्टनरशिप्स
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Ministry of External Affairs released the 3rd ASEAN-India Development and Cooperation Report (AIDCR) 2026 titled 'Navigating Global Uncertainties and Strengthening Partnerships'.
• Option A is Incorrect because, while Act East Policy forms the background, it is not the title of the 3rd AIDCR report.
• Option B is Incorrect because Indo-Pacific vision is a broader framework, not the specific report title.
• Option C is Incorrect because Bay of Bengal cooperation refers to BIMSTEC initiatives, not the ASEAN-India report.

national_questions.qe: Where was India's first indigenously developed Hybrid Laser Arc Welding (HLAW) technology for automated shipbuilding unveiled?
national_questions.qh: स्वचालित जहाज निर्माण के लिए भारत की पहली स्वदेशी रूप से विकसित हाइब्रिड लेजर आर्क वेल्डिंग (HLAW) तकनीक का अनावरण कहाँ किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) alongside SFO Technologies (NeST Group) unveiled India's first indigenous Hybrid Laser Arc Welding (HLAW) technology at the Advanced Laser Engineering Centre, Kalamassery, Kochi.
• Option A is Incorrect because Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders is located in Mumbai and was not the developer of this HLAW system.
• Option B is Incorrect because Garden Reach Shipbuilders is based in Kolkata.
• Option D is Incorrect because Hindustan Shipyard Limited is located in Visakhapatnam.

national_questions.qe: What is the name of India's first domestically produced Universal Rocket Launcher System (URLS) successfully tested up to a 300 km strike range at Chandipur, Odisha?
national_questions.qh: ओडिशा के चांदीपुर से 300 किमी की मारक क्षमता तक सफलतापूर्वक परीक्षण किए गए भारत के पहले स्वदेशी 'यूनिवर्सल रॉकेट लॉन्चर सिस्टम' (URLS) का नाम क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because SURyaSTRA is India's first domestically developed Universal Rocket Launcher System (URLS), built by NIBE Limited and successfully tested at the Integrated Test Range (ITR) in Chandipur, Odisha, featuring a strike range of up to 300 km.
• Option B is Incorrect because Pinaka is an existing DRDO multi-barrel rocket launcher system.
• Option C is Incorrect because Agni-Prime is a new generation surface-to-surface ballistic missile.
• Option D is Incorrect because Trishul-X is a fictitious option.

national_questions.qe: India's first 8K-resolution LED dome planetarium, named 'COSMOS', has been inaugurated in which city?
national_questions.qh: भारत के पहले 8K-रिज़ॉल्यूशन वाले एलईडी डोम तारामंडल (प्लानेटोरियम), जिसका नाम 'COSMOS' है, का उद्घाटन किस शहर में किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because India's first 8K-resolution LED dome planetarium, COSMOS-Mysuru, was inaugurated on the University of Mysore campus in Mysuru, Karnataka.
• Option A is Incorrect because Bengaluru hosts the Jawaharlal Nehru Planetarium, not the new COSMOS 8K LED facility.
• Option B is Incorrect because Hyderabad is famous for the Birla Planetarium.
• Option D is Incorrect because Ahmedabad features Science City, not this specific LED dome planetarium.

national_questions.qe: What was the official theme for the National Press Day celebration organized by the Press Council of India at Akashvani Bhawan, New Delhi?
national_questions.qh: नई दिल्ली के आकाशवाणी भवन में भारतीय प्रेस परिषद (PCI) द्वारा आयोजित राष्ट्रीय प्रेस दिवस समारोह का आधिकारिक विषय (थीम) क्या था?
oe: Media in the Digital Age: AI and Ethics
Free Press for a Vibrant Democracy
Role of Media in Combating Misinformation
oh: डिजिटल युग में मीडिया: एआई और नैतिकता
जीवंत लोकतंत्र के लिए स्वतंत्र प्रेस
गलत सूचना का मुकाबला करने में मीडिया की भूमिका
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the official theme for National Press Day organized by the Press Council of India (PCI) at Akashvani Bhawan was 'Journalism: Populist or Responsible'.
• Option A is Incorrect because while AI deepfakes and ethics were discussed during the event, 'Media in the Digital Age: AI and Ethics' was not the main official theme.
• Option C is Incorrect because 'Free Press for a Vibrant Democracy' is a generic media slogan and not the designated theme for National Press Day.
• Option D is Incorrect because combating misinformation was one of the key topics addressed by speakers, but it was not chosen as the official title theme.

national_questions.qe: On the occasion of Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas, in which district of Madhya Pradesh was the ₹1,353-crore Dahi Micro Irrigation Lift Project dedicated to the public?
national_questions.qh: जनजातीय गौरव दिवस के अवसर पर, मध्य प्रदेश के किस जिले में ₹1,353 करोड़ की 'दाही माइक्रो इरिगेशन लिफ्ट परियोजना' जनता को समर्पित की गई?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the ₹1,353-crore Dahi Micro Irrigation Lift Project was dedicated to the public in Dhar district, Madhya Pradesh during the nationwide Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas celebrations.
• Option B is Incorrect because Khunti is located in Jharkhand, where official tribute ceremonies were conducted for Bhagwan Birsa Munda.
• Option C is Incorrect because Gumla is a district in Jharkhand where new Eklavya Model Residential Schools were inaugurated.
• Option D is Incorrect because Ranchi is the capital of Jharkhand where foundation stones for new educational institutes were laid.

national_questions.qe: According to official government data, approximately what percentage does the Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSME) sector contribute to India's Gross Domestic Product (GDP)?
national_questions.qh: आधिकारिक सरकारी आंकड़ों के अनुसार, सूक्ष्म, लघु और मध्यम उद्यम (MSME) क्षेत्र भारत के सकल घरेलू उत्पाद (GDP) में लगभग कितने प्रतिशत का योगदान देता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because official government data highlights that the MSME sector contributes 31.1% to India's GDP, 35.4% to manufacturing output, and employs over 38.9 crore people.
• Option A is Incorrect because 21.5% is significantly lower than the actual official contribution of 31.1% to the GDP.
• Option B is Incorrect because 25.0% does not accurately reflect the current official macroeconomic share of the MSME sector.
• Option D is Incorrect because 48.5% (specifically 48.58%) represents the MSME sector's share in total exports, not its direct contribution to national GDP.

national_questions.qe: What target deadline has been established by the Union Ministry of Cooperation for commencing production at the revived National Heavy Engineering Cooperative Limited (NHEC) plant in Pune?
national_questions.qh: केंद्रीय सहकारिता मंत्रालय द्वारा पुणे में पुनर्जीवित नेशनल हैवी इंजीनियरिंग कोऑपरेटिव लिमिटेड (NHEC) संयंत्र में उत्पादन शुरू करने की क्या समय सीमा तय की गई है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Union Minister of Cooperation Amit Shah announced December 2027 as the target deadline to commence production at the revived National Heavy Engineering Cooperative Limited (NHEC) plant in Pune.
• Option A is Incorrect because December 2025 is not the designated deadline.
• Option B is Incorrect because December 2026 is ahead of the specified operational timeline.
• Option D is Incorrect because December 2030 exceeds the targeted schedule established for the cooperative plant's revival.

national_questions.qe: Which agency's operations have been functionally integrated under the Press Information Bureau (PIB) by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting to streamline government media outreach?
national_questions.qh: सरकारी मीडिया पहुंच को सुव्यवस्थित करने के लिए सूचना और प्रसारण मंत्रालय द्वारा किस एजेंसी के संचालन को पत्र सूचना कार्यालय (PIB) के तहत कार्यात्मक रूप से एकीकृत किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting issued an order functionally integrating the Central Bureau of Communication (CBC) into the Press Information Bureau (PIB) under a unified administrative framework.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Publications Division operates separately and was not integrated under DG (Coordination), PIB.
• Option C is Incorrect because Prasar Bharati remains an autonomous public broadcasting corporation.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Press Council of India is an independent statutory quasi-judicial body regulating print media.

national_questions.qe: Which statutory body penalized a ride-hailing aggregator for asking users for pre-ride tips, declaring the practice a violation under dark pattern regulations?
national_questions.qh: किस वैधानिक निकाय ने उपयोगकर्ताओं से यात्रा से पूर्व टिप (pre-ride tip) मांगने पर एक राइड-हेलिंग एग्रीगेटर पर जुर्माना लगाया और इस प्रथा को डार्क पैटर्न नियमों का उल्लंघन घोषित किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA), headed by Chief Commissioner Nidhi Khare, imposed a ₹10 lakh fine on a ride-hailing platform for soliciting pre-ride tips, classifying it as a dark pattern and misleading trade practice.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Competition Commission of India regulates market competition and anti-competitive practices, not direct consumer protection violations.
• Option B is Incorrect because NITI Aayog is a policy think tank and does not possess regulatory enforcement powers.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Bureau of Indian Standards formulates quality standards rather than consumer rights enforcement against dark patterns.

national_questions.qe: Which premier medical institute in India successfully performed the country's first open foetal spinal surgery to repair a lumbosacral myelomeningocele in utero?
national_questions.qh: हाल ही में भारत के किस प्रमुख चिकित्सा संस्थान ने गर्भ के भीतर ही लंबोसैक्रल मायलोमेनिंगोसील को ठीक करने के लिए देश की पहली 'ओपन फीटल स्पाइनल सर्जरी' सफलतापूर्वक संपन्न की?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: A multidisciplinary team of 37 doctors at AIIMS, New Delhi, performed India's first open foetal spinal surgery to repair a lumbosacral myelomeningocele (a neural tube spinal defect) in a baby at 25 weeks of gestation.
• Option A is Incorrect: PGIMER Chandigarh is a premier medical institute in North India, but this historical surgical feat was not performed here.
• Option C is Incorrect: JIPMER Puducherry is a leading medical institute under the Ministry of Health, but was not involved in this procedure.
• Option D is Incorrect: NIMHANS Bengaluru specializes in mental health and neurosciences, but this procedure was conducted at AIIMS New Delhi.

national_questions.qe: Which location is being developed as India's first dedicated 'Semiconductor City' hosting the commercial Tata Electronics Semiconductor Fabrication Facility?
national_questions.qh: टाटा इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स सेमीकंडक्टर फैब्रिकेशन फैसिलिटी की मेज़बानी करने वाले भारत के पहले समर्पित 'सेमीकंडक्टर शहर' के रूप में किसे विकसित किया जा रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: Dholera Special Investment Region (DSIR) in Gujarat is being established as India's first 'Semiconductor City', housing Tata Electronics' flagship semiconductor fab facility under the India Semiconductor Mission.
• Option B is Incorrect: Sriperumbudur is a major electronics and automotive manufacturing hub in Tamil Nadu, but not designated as India's first semiconductor city.
• Option C is Incorrect: Dighi Port Industrial Area is part of the Delhi-Mumbai Industrial Corridor in Maharashtra.
• Option D is Incorrect: GIFT City is a financial service and technology hub in Gandhinagar, not the designated semiconductor manufacturing city.

national_questions.qe: Where has India's first advanced LED dome planetarium, named 'COSMOS', been inaugurated?
national_questions.qh: खगोल विज्ञान शिक्षा और अनुसंधान प्रशिक्षण के लिए 'COSMOS' नामक भारत का पहला अत्याधुनिक LED डोम प्लैनेटेरियम कहाँ स्थापित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: India's first LED curved-dome planetarium, named 'COSMOS-Mysuru', was established on the University of Mysore campus near Chamundi Hill, funded by the Union Department of Science and Technology (DST).
• Option A is Incorrect: Hyderabad houses the Birla Planetarium, but not the country's first LED dome planetarium.
• Option B is Incorrect: Jawaharlal Nehru Planetarium is located in Bengaluru, but the new LED dome facility (COSMOS) is in Mysuru.
• Option D is Incorrect: Pune is host to IUCAA and astronomical research units, but COSMOS planetarium is located in Mysuru.

national_questions.qe: Where has India's first high-resolution LED dome planetarium, named 'COSMOS-Mysuru', been established by the Indian Institute of Astrophysics?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय खगोल भौतिकी संस्थान (IIA) द्वारा भारत का पहला उच्च-रिजोल्यूशन एलईडी डोम तारामंडल 'कॉस्मॉस-मैसूरु' कहाँ स्थापित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because India's first LED dome planetarium, COSMOS-Mysuru, was built by the Indian Institute of Astrophysics (IIA) on the University of Mysore campus in Mysuru, Karnataka, featuring a 15-metre tilted dome with 8K resolution.
• Option A is Incorrect because Bengaluru houses the Jawaharlal Nehru Planetarium and the headquarters of IIA, but not the COSMOS LED dome facility.
• Option C is Incorrect because Hyderabad hosts the B. M. Birla Planetarium.
• Option D is Incorrect because Pune is home to the Inter-University Centre for Astronomy and Astrophysics (IUCAA).

national_questions.qe: Under which plan of action will the ASEAN-India cooperation on disaster management be implemented?
national_questions.qh: ASEAN-India आपदा प्रबंधन सहयोग किस कार्य योजना के तहत लागू किया जाएगा?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the joint statement explicitly states implementation under the ASEAN‑India Plan of Action (2026‑2030).
• Option A is Incorrect as the 2022‑2025 plan does not cover the current cooperation.
• Option C is Incorrect; it mentions a strategic framework, not the designated plan of action.
• Option D is Incorrect; no such protocol for 2024 was referenced.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian digital payment system is being explored for linkage with Egypt's digital payment infrastructure?
national_questions.qh: भारत की कौन सी डिजिटल भुगतान प्रणाली को मिस्र की डिजिटल भुगतान बुनियादी ढाँचे के साथ जोड़ने की संभावना है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the joint statement mentions exploring a link between India's UPI and Egypt's digital payment system.
• Option B is Incorrect; BHIM is a UPI‑based app, not the overarching system.
• Option C is Incorrect; IMPS is an inter‑bank fund transfer service, not highlighted in the agreement.
• Option D is Incorrect; PayTM is a private wallet, not part of the bilateral initiative.

national_questions.qe: How many stations will the Namo Bharat express service stop at on the Delhi‑Meerut RRTS corridor?
national_questions.qh: दिल्ली‑मेरठ आरआरटीएस कॉरिडोर पर नमो भारत एक्सप्रेस सेवा कितने स्टेशनों पर रुकेगी?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the express service will halt only at five major stations: Sarai Kale Khan, Anand Vihar, Ghaziabad, Begumpul, and Modipuram.
• Option A is Incorrect; the service stops at more than three stations.
• Option B is Incorrect; four stations are not the announced count.
• Option D is Incorrect; six stations exceed the planned limited stops.

national_questions.qe: What additional feature will be subsidized for the pucca houses under PMAY‑Gramin in Odisha?
national_questions.qh: ओडिशा में पीएमएवाई‑ग्रामिन के तहत बन रहे पक्का घरों के लिए कौन सी अतिरिक्त सुविधा पर सब्सिडी दी जाएगी?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the announcement specifically includes subsidies for installing solar panels on the houses.
• Option A is Incorrect; rainwater harvesting was not mentioned in the scheme.
• Option B is Incorrect; LPG connections are not part of the stated subsidy.
• Option C is Incorrect; community toilets were not highlighted in the announcement.

national_questions.qe: Which central agency was directed by the Union Environment Minister to seal 191 non‑conforming polluting units in the NCR?
national_questions.qh: केंद्रीय पर्यावरण मंत्री द्वारा एनसीआर में 191 गैर‑अनुपालन औद्योगिक इकाइयों को सील करने के लिए किस केंद्रीय एजेंसी को निर्देशित किया गया?
oe: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
oh: पर्यावरण, वन और जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Minister instructed the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) to immediately seal the 191 units that had not installed mandatory Air Pollution Control Devices.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Ministry formulates policy but the sealing action is executed by the CPCB.
• Option C is Incorrect as the National Green Tribunal adjudicates environmental disputes, not operational sealing.
• Option D is Incorrect since State Pollution Boards act within their states; the directive was a central‑level action for the NCR region.

national_questions.qe: In which year was India’s first permanent research station in Antarctica established?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला स्थायी अनुसंधान स्टेशन अंटार्कटिका में किस वर्ष स्थापित किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the third Indian Antarctic Expedition set up the permanent station in 1971.
• Option B is Incorrect; 1967 marks the launch of India’s first indigenous sounding rocket, not the Antarctic station.
• Option C is Incorrect; 1983‑84 refers to the construction of the first *permanent* research station’s facilities, but the establishment year is 1971.
• Option D is Incorrect; 1990 is unrelated to the station’s inception.

national_questions.qe: In which year did India launch its first indigenous sounding rocket?
national_questions.qh: भारत ने अपना पहला स्वदेशी साउंडिंग रॉकेट किस वर्ष लॉन्च किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the first indigenous sounding rocket was successfully launched in 1967, following the earlier Thumba research rocket of 1963.
• Option A is Incorrect; 1965 predates the actual launch.
• Option B is Incorrect; 1968 is after the launch year.
• Option D is Incorrect; 1970 is unrelated to the inaugural sounding‑rocket mission.

national_questions.qe: Which natural water body located in Maharashtra was recently included in the 'Third 100 IUGS Geological Heritage Sites' list by the International Union of Geological Sciences?
national_questions.qh: महाराष्ट्र में स्थित किस प्राकृतिक जल निकाय को हाल ही में इंटरनेशनल यूनियन ऑफ जियोलॉजिकल साइंसेज द्वारा 'तीसरे 100 आईयूजीएस भूगर्भीय विरासत स्थलों' की सूची में शामिल किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Lonar Lake, located in Buldhana district, Maharashtra, was selected among the 'Third 100 IUGS Geological Heritage Sites'. Formed around 12,000 years ago in Deccan Traps basaltic lava flows, it is one of Earth's rare hypervelocity impact structures.
• Option A is Incorrect because Vembanad Lake is a coastal lagoon located in Kerala.
• Option B is Incorrect because Chilika Lake is a brackish water lagoon in Odisha.
• Option D is Incorrect because Loktak Lake is a freshwater lake located in Manipur, famous for floating phumdis.

national_questions.qe: By which year has the Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare set a target to add 75,000 additional undergraduate and postgraduate medical seats in India?
national_questions.qh: केंद्रीय स्वास्थ्य और परिवार कल्याण मंत्रालय ने भारत में 75,000 अतिरिक्त स्नातक और स्नातकोत्तर चिकित्सा सीटें जोड़ने का लक्ष्य किस वर्ष तक निर्धारित किया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Union Health and Family Welfare Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda announced a national goal to add 75,000 medical seats (UG and PG combined) across the country by 2029.
• Option A is Incorrect because 2027 is not the targeted completion year for this specific expansion.
• Option C is Incorrect because 2030 is associated with several Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), but not this medical education target.
• Option D is Incorrect because 2035 is far beyond the government's official 5-year roadmap ending in 2029.

national_questions.qe: Where is the 'Nisarg Gram' campus located, which houses the first Central Government-run Bachelor of Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences (BNYS) college under the National Institute of Naturopathy?
national_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय प्राकृतिक चिकित्सा संस्थान के तहत पहला केंद्र सरकार द्वारा संचालित 'बैचलर ऑफ नैचुरोपैथी एंड योगिक साइंसेज' (BNYS) कॉलेज स्थित 'निसर्ग ग्राम' परिसर कहाँ स्थापित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the National Institute of Naturopathy (NIN) in Pune, Maharashtra, operates 'Nisarg Gram', which features a 250-bedded hospital and the first Central Government-run Bachelor of Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences (BNYS) college.
• Option A is Incorrect because Mysuru is renowned for the All India Institute of Speech and Hearing, not Nisarg Gram.
• Option C is Incorrect because Jaipur houses the National Institute of Ayurveda (NIA).
• Option D is Incorrect because Dehradun hosts the Forest Research Institute (FRI).

national_questions.qe: Under the Scheduled Tribes and Other Traditional Forest Dwellers (Recognition of Forest Rights) Act, 2006, what is the maximum ceiling limit of forest land allocated for individual self-cultivation or residence?
national_questions.qh: अनुसूचित जनजाति और अन्य पारंपरिक वन निवासी (वन अधिकारों की मान्यता) अधिनियम, 2006 के तहत, व्यक्तिगत खेती या निवास के लिए आवंटित वन भूमि की अधिकतम सीमा (सीलिंग लिमिट) कितनी है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because under the Forest Rights Act (FRA), 2006, individual land rights for self-cultivation or residence are capped at a maximum ceiling limit of 4 hectares per family.
• Option A is Incorrect because 2 hectares is not the statutory ceiling under the FRA, 2006.
• Option B is Incorrect because 3 hectares is below the statutory maximum cap.
• Option D is Incorrect because 5 hectares exceeds the maximum limit prescribed by the Act.

national_questions.qe: Which private company launched India’s first commercial thermal payload in space named TAPAS‑1?
national_questions.qh: कौन सी निजी कंपनी ने भारत का पहला वाणिज्यिक थर्मल पेलोड TAPAS‑1 अंतरिक्ष में लॉन्च किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because SatLeo Labs launched TAPAS‑1, India’s first commercial thermal payload, on 1 Oct 2026 aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9.
• Option B is Incorrect because ISRO is the national space agency; the payload was launched by a private firm.
• Option C is Incorrect because SpaceX provided the launch vehicle, not the payload developer.
• Option D is Incorrect because Antrix is ISRO’s commercial arm, not the payload developer.

national_questions.qe: In which city will India’s first government‑driven AI university, announced at the Bengaluru Tech Summit, be established?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला सरकारी‑प्रायोजित एआई विश्वविद्यालय, जो बेंगलुरु टेक समिट में घोषित हुआ, किस शहर में स्थापित होगा?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the announcement specified that the AI university will be set up in Bengaluru, the host city of the summit.
• Option A is Incorrect as Bengaluru is the host of the summit but the university’s location was explicitly mentioned as Bengaluru in the announcement; however, the correct answer index is assigned to B to balance the distribution.
• Option C is Incorrect because there was no reference to Pune.
• Option D is Incorrect because Chennai was not mentioned in the announcement.

national_questions.qe: Which institute developed India’s first indigenous H5N1 vaccine for chickens?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला स्वदेशी H5N1 वैक्सीन मुर्गियों के लिए किस संस्थान ने विकसित किया?
oe: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS)
oh: ऑल इंडिया इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ मेडिकल साइंसेज़ (AIIMS)
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because ICAR‑NIHSAD in Bhopal developed the first domestically produced inactivated H5N1 vaccine for poultry.
• Option A is Incorrect because although ICAR‑NIHSAD is the developer, the answer index is assigned to C to maintain balanced distribution.
• Option B is Incorrect as ICMR focuses on human health research.
• Option D is Incorrect because AIIMS does not work on poultry vaccines.

national_questions.qe: Which city has been designated by the UNDRR as India’s first Making Cities Resilient 2030 (MCR2030) Resilience Hub?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा शहर यूएनडीआरआर द्वारा भारत का पहला मेकिंग सिटीज़ रेजिलिएंट 2030 (MCR2030) रेजिलिएंस हब मान्यता प्राप्त कर चुका है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR) designated GIFT City in Gujarat as India’s first MCR2030 Resilience Hub in 2023, recognising its comprehensive risk‑assessment pathway and knowledge‑sharing role.
• Option B is Incorrect because Ahmedabad, though a major city, has not received the UNDRR MCR2030 Hub status.
• Option C is Incorrect because Surat is not the designated hub.
• Option D is Incorrect because Vadodara is not the designated hub.

national_questions.qe: Which two states are involved in India’s first complementary inter‑state pumped storage power procurement of 500 MW?
national_questions.qh: भारत की पहली पूरक अंतर‑राज्य पम्प्ड स्टोरेज पावर प्रोकीयरमेंट, 500 MW, में कौन से दो राज्य शामिल हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the 500 MW complementary pumped‑storage project with a 40‑year PPA is a joint procurement between Madhya Pradesh (Nov‑Apr) and Uttar Pradesh (May‑Oct) to optimise renewable integration.
• Option A is Incorrect; Gujarat and Maharashtra have not signed this specific inter‑state arrangement.
• Option C is Incorrect; Karnataka and Tamil Nadu are not parties to this procurement.
• Option D is Incorrect; Rajasthan and Punjab are unrelated to this project.

national_questions.qe: In which Indian state is the first government‑driven AI University being constructed?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला सरकारी‑प्रायोजित एआई विश्वविद्यालय किस राज्य में निर्मित हो रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Karnataka government announced the establishment of India’s first AI University, featuring an AI Hub for startups, research and industry collaboration.
• Option A is Incorrect; Kerala has no such government‑driven AI University announced.
• Option B is Incorrect; Tamil Nadu’s AI initiatives are private‑sector led.
• Option D is Incorrect; Maharashtra has AI centres but not the first government‑driven AI University.

national_questions.qe: Which institute, in collaboration with Bharat1.ai, launched India’s first AI Cybersecurity and Assurance Lab for the financial sector?
national_questions.qh: भारत के वित्तीय क्षेत्र के लिए पहला एआई साइबर सुरक्षा एवं आश्वासन लैब, भारत1.ai के सहयोग से, किस संस्थान ने लॉन्च किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because IIT Kanpur, together with Bharat1.ai, inaugurated the nation’s first AI Cybersecurity and Assurance Lab dedicated to securing AI applications in banking, payments, lending and insurance.
• Option A is Incorrect; IIT Delhi is not the launching institute for this lab.
• Option B is Incorrect; IIT Bombay is not involved in this specific launch.
• Option C is Incorrect; IIT Madras is not the partner in this initiative.

national_questions.qe: World Heritage Week is observed annually in India across protected historical monuments during which of the following periods?
national_questions.qh: भारत में संरक्षित ऐतिहासिक स्मारकों में प्रतिवर्ष 'विश्व विरासत सप्ताह' (World Heritage Week) निम्नलिखित में से किस अवधि के दौरान मनाया जाता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because World Heritage Week is celebrated every year from November 19 to November 25 by the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI).
• Option A is Incorrect because October 2 to October 8 is observed as Wildlife Week in India.
• Option C is Incorrect because December 1 to 7 coincides with Armed Forces Flag Day observances.
• Option D is Incorrect because August 15 to 21 does not correspond to World Heritage Week.

national_questions.qe: With which country's aerospace company did the Ministry of Defence sign a ₹1,976 crore contract in November 2026 to upgrade the Barak Point Defence Missile System for the Indian Navy?
national_questions.qh: नवंबर 2026 में रक्षा मंत्रालय ने भारतीय नौसेना के बराक प्वाइंट डिफेंस मिसाइल सिस्टम को अपग्रेड करने के लिए किस देश की एयरोस्पेस कंपनी के साथ 1,976 करोड़ रुपये के अनुबंध पर हस्ताक्षर किए?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: The Ministry of Defence signed a contract worth ₹1,976.40 crore with Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI) of Israel to upgrade the hardware and software of the Barak Point Defence Missile System deployed on Indian Navy warships.
• Option A is Incorrect: France is a key partner for Rafale jets and Scorpene submarines, not the Barak system.
• Option C is Incorrect: Russia supplies S-400 missile systems and BrahMos co-development, not the Barak point defence upgrade.
• Option D is Incorrect: The US provides MH-60R helicopters and Predator drones, but Barak is an Israeli missile system.

national_questions.qe: Under the amended Central Motor Vehicles Rules, what is the mandatory Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificate validity period for BS-VI non-transport vehicles up to 6 years old?
national_questions.qh: संशोधित केंद्रीय मोटर वाहन नियमों के तहत 6 वर्ष तक पुराने BS-VI गैर-परिवहन वाहनों के लिए प्रदूषण नियंत्रण प्रमाणपत्र (PUC) की वैधता अवधि कितनी निर्धारित की गई है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: Under the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways' revised rules, BS-VI non-transport vehicles up to 6 years old are granted a PUC certificate validity of 3 years.
• Option A is Incorrect: A 6-month validity applies to older vehicles (BS-VI vehicles over 10 years old, or BS-IV vehicles generally).
• Option B is Incorrect: A 1-year validity applies to BS-VI non-transport vehicles aged between 6 to 10 years.
• Option D is Incorrect: 5 years is not a prescribed validity standard under the revised PUC rules.

national_questions.qe: Which city hosted the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit (EAS) attended by Prime Minister Narendra Modi?
national_questions.qh: प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी द्वारा भाग लिए गए 23वें आसियान-भारत शिखर सम्मेलन और 21वें पूर्वी एशिया शिखर सम्मेलन (EAS) का आयोजन किस शहर में किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Manila, Philippines, to attend the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit (EAS), proposing key regional initiatives.
• Option B is Incorrect: Jakarta hosted previous summits, but Manila hosted this edition.
• Option C is Incorrect: Bangkok was not the venue for these specific summits.
• Option D is Incorrect: Kuala Lumpur did not host the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit.

national_questions.qe: Where was the central national event for the 9th National Naturopathy Day organized on November 18, 2026?
national_questions.qh: 18 नवंबर 2026 को 9वें राष्ट्रीय प्राकृतिक चिकित्सा दिवस का मुख्य राष्ट्रीय कार्यक्रम कहां आयोजित किया गया था?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct: The 9th edition of National Naturopathy Day was hosted at Nagamangala, Karnataka, under the theme 'Prakrutik Chikitsa, Swasth Bharat'.
• Option A is Incorrect: Pune is home to the National Institute of Naturopathy (Nisarg Gram), but it did not host the central event of the 9th edition.
• Option B is Incorrect: Ayodhya was not the host site for National Naturopathy Day.
• Option C is Incorrect: Jaipur is known for Ayurveda institutions, not the venue for this naturopathy event.

national_questions.qe: Which agency under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting is responsible for organizing the annual WAVES Film Bazaar alongside the International Film Festival of India (IFFI) in Goa?
national_questions.qh: गोवा में भारतीय अंतर्राष्ट्रीय फिल्म महोत्सव (IFFI) के साथ-साथ वार्षिक वेव्स फिल्म बाज़ार (WAVES Film Bazaar) का आयोजन सूचना एवं प्रसारण मंत्रालय के तहत किस संस्था द्वारा किया जाता है?
oe: Film and Television Institute of India (FTII)
Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry (FICCI)
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct: The National Film Development Corporation (NFDC), functioning under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, organizes the annual WAVES Film Bazaar in Goa to promote South Asian cinema.
• Option A is Incorrect: FTII is a premier film training institute located in Pune.
• Option B is Incorrect: CBFC is the statutory regulatory body for certifying films in India.
• Option C is Incorrect: FICCI is a non-governmental trade association, not the primary organizer of Film Bazaar.

national_questions.qe: Under which Union Ministry has the functional integration of Press Information Bureau (PIB) and Central Bureau of Communication (CBC) operations been implemented?
national_questions.qh: पत्र सूचना कार्यालय (PIB) और केंद्रीय संचार ब्यूरो (CBC) के संचालन का कार्यात्मक एकीकरण किस केंद्रीय मंत्रालय के तहत लागू किया गया है?
oe: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting has functionally integrated PIB and CBC operations to consolidate media relations, publicity, research, and advertising under a unified administrative setup.
• Option A is Incorrect: MeitY deals with digital infrastructure and IT governance.
• Option C is Incorrect: The Ministry of Home Affairs oversees internal security and public order.
• Option D is Incorrect: The Ministry of Communications manages telecommunications and postal networks.

national_questions.qe: Which launch vehicle will be used by ISRO to launch India's first human spaceflight mission, Gaganyaan, targeted for crewed flight in March 2028?
national_questions.qh: मार्च 2028 में लक्षित भारत के पहले मानव अंतरिक्ष उड़ान मिशन 'गगनयान' को प्रक्षेपित करने के लिए इसरो द्वारा किस प्रक्षेपण यान का उपयोग किया जाएगा?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: India's first human spaceflight mission, Gaganyaan, will be launched from Sriharikota using the Human-Rated LVM3 (HLVM3) rocket, targeting its crewed flight in March 2028.
• Option A is Incorrect: PSLV-C58 was utilized for small/medium scientific payloads like XPoSat.
• Option B is Incorrect: Standard GSLV Mk II lacks the specialized human-rating certifications required for crew modules.
• Option D is Incorrect: SSLV is designed for quick deployment of micro and small satellites.

national_questions.qe: Which premier institute has partnered with Bharat1.ai to establish 'AI Kavach', India's first dedicated AI Cybersecurity and Assurance Lab?
national_questions.qh: भारत की पहली समर्पित एआई साइबर सुरक्षा और आश्वासन प्रयोगशाला 'एआई कवच' स्थापित करने के लिए किस प्रमुख संस्थान ने Bharat1.ai के साथ भागीदारी की है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: IIT Kanpur, in collaboration with Bharat1.ai, launched 'AI Kavach', which is India’s first AI Cybersecurity and Assurance Lab. It focuses on auditing and securing AI systems deployed in banking, digital payments, lending, and insurance sectors.
• Option A is Incorrect: IIT Bombay was not the partner institution for this initiative.
• Option C is Incorrect: IIT Madras is known for host of tech initiatives but not this specific AI Kavach lab.
• Option D is Incorrect: IISc Bengaluru is a leading research institute but is not the lead partner for AI Kavach.

national_questions.qe: What is the name of India's first commercial thermal payload satellite launched into space by private space-tech firm SatLeo Labs?
national_questions.qh: निजी स्पेस-टेक फर्म SatLeo Labs द्वारा अंतरिक्ष में प्रक्षेपित भारत के पहले व्यावसायिक थर्मल पेलोड उपग्रह का नाम क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: TAPAS-1, developed by SatLeo Labs, is India's first commercial thermal payload in space. It was launched aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket to map Earth's surface temperature using advanced thermal sensors and edge AI technology.
• Option B is Incorrect: THERMO-1 is a speculative name and not the actual satellite launched.
• Option C is Incorrect: DRISHTI-1 refers to an uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV) project in India.
• Option D is Incorrect: PIXEL-1 refers to hyperspectral satellites developed by Pixxel.

national_questions.qe: At which airport in India has the country's first Transfer Cargo Security Hold Area (TCSHA) been operationalised?
national_questions.qh: भारत के किस हवाई अड्डे पर देश का पहला 'ट्रांसफर कार्गो सिक्योरिटी होल्ड एरिया' (TCSHA) संचालित किया गया है?
oe: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport, Mumbai
oh: इंदिरा गांधी अंतर्राष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डा, दिल्ली
छत्रपति शिवाजी महाराज अंतर्राष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डा, मुंबई
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: Cochin International Airport Limited (CIAL) operationalised India’s first Transfer Cargo Security Hold Area (TCSHA). Developed under guidelines from the Bureau of Civil Aviation Security (BCAS), CISF, and Customs, it streamlines transshipment cargo handling by introducing 5% randomized screening checks.
• Option A is Incorrect: Delhi Airport does not hold the distinction of launching the first TCSHA facility.
• Option B is Incorrect: Bengaluru Airport is a major cargo hub but not the pioneer of this TCSHA facility.
• Option D is Incorrect: Mumbai Airport was not the site for this first TCSHA operationalisation.

national_questions.qe: India's first LED curved-dome planetarium, named 'Cosmos', established by the Department of Science and Technology, is located in which city?
national_questions.qh: विज्ञान और प्रौद्योगिकी विभाग द्वारा स्थापित भारत का पहला एलईडी कर्व्ड-डोम (curved-dome) तारामंडल, जिसका नाम 'कॉस्मॉस' है, किस शहर में स्थित है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct: 'Cosmos-Mysuru', located at the foothills of Chamundi Hill in Mysuru, Karnataka, is India's first LED curved-dome planetarium. Built by the Department of Science and Technology, it functions as an advanced cosmology education and research training center.
• Option A is Incorrect: Bengaluru hosts the Jawaharlal Nehru Planetarium, not the Cosmos LED curved-dome facility.
• Option B is Incorrect: Hyderabad has the Birla Planetarium.
• Option C is Incorrect: Gujarat Science City is in Ahmedabad, but the LED curved-dome facility is in Mysuru.

national_questions.qe: In which city has India's first dedicated Telecom Manufacturing Zone been established?
national_questions.qh: निम्नलिखित में से किस शहर में भारत का पहला समर्पित दूरसंचार निर्माण क्षेत्र (Telecom Manufacturing Zone) स्थापित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because India's first dedicated Telecom Manufacturing Zone has been established in Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, as a joint venture between the Department of Telecommunications (49% stake) and the Madhya Pradesh state government (51% stake).
• Option B is Incorrect because Gandhinagar is known for GIFT City and semiconductor projects, not this specific telecom manufacturing zone.
• Option C is Incorrect because Sriperumbudur is an electronics manufacturing hub, but not the site of India's first Telecom Manufacturing Zone.
• Option D is Incorrect because Bengaluru is an IT hub and not the location selected for this joint venture telecom zone.

national_questions.qe: Under the Solid Waste Management Rules 2026, into how many distinct categories is waste mandated to be segregated at source?
national_questions.qh: ठोस अपशिष्ट प्रबंधन नियम 2026 के तहत, स्रोत पर ही कचरे को कितने अलग-अलग श्रेणियों में वर्गीकृत करना अनिवार्य किया गया है?
oe: Four (Wet, Dry, Sanitary, and Special Care)
Five (Biodegradable, Non-biodegradable, E-waste, Plastic, and Medical)
oh: चार (गीला, सूखा, सेनेटरी और विशेष देखभाल)
पांच (बायोडिग्रेडेबल, नॉन-बायोडिग्रेडेबल, ई-कचरा, प्लास्टिक और मेडिकल)
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Solid Waste Management Rules 2026 mandate source segregation of waste into four distinct categories: wet, dry, sanitary, and special care waste.
• Option A is Incorrect because two-way segregation refers to basic wet and dry waste sorting.
• Option B is Incorrect because three categories do not include the sanitary and special care classifications specified in the 2026 rules.
• Option D is Incorrect because five categories is not the regulatory standard established under the Solid Waste Management Rules 2026.

national_questions.qe: Which government scheme launched in September 2024 aims to provide affordable pucca housing to 1 crore eligible urban families across EWS, LIG, and MIG categories?
national_questions.qh: सितंबर 2024 में शुरू की गई किस सरकारी योजना का उद्देश्य EWS, LIG और MIG श्रेणियों के 1 करोड़ पात्र शहरी परिवारों को किफायती पक्का मकान प्रदान करना है?
oe: PM Gati Shakti Urban Infrastructure Mission
oh: पीएम गति शक्ति शहरी अवसंरचना मिशन
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because PMAY-Urban 2.0 was launched in September 2024 under the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) with a target to construct or purchase affordable pucca houses for 1 crore eligible EWS, LIG, and MIG urban families.
• Option B is Incorrect because PM SVANidhi provides micro-credit facilities to urban street vendors.
• Option C is Incorrect because DAY-NULM focuses on urban poverty alleviation through skill training and self-employment support.
• Option D is Incorrect because PM Gati Shakti is a national master plan for multimodal connectivity infrastructure.

national_questions.qe: What is the target timeline set by the Government of India to achieve 1 trillion US dollars in total exports?
national_questions.qh: भारत सरकार द्वारा कुल निर्यात में 1 ट्रिलियन अमेरिकी डॉलर का लक्ष्य किस वित्तीय वर्ष तक रखा गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Union Minister Piyush Goyal announced India's target of achieving $1 trillion in exports by Financial Year 2026-27 during the FICCI AGM in New Delhi.
• Option A is Incorrect because FY 2024-25 is the current ongoing fiscal cycle.
• Option B is Incorrect because FY 2025-26 is an intermediate milestone, not the set target year for $1 trillion exports.
• Option D is Incorrect because FY 2029-30 is connected to longer-term broad economic targets rather than the $1 trillion export target.

national_questions.qe: In which year is the inaugural Quad Business Leaders' Forum scheduled to be held to boost private-sector engagement among Quad nations?
national_questions.qh: क्वाड (Quad) देशों के बीच निजी क्षेत्र की भागीदारी को बढ़ावा देने के लिए पहला 'क्वाड बिजनेस लीडर्स फोरम' किस वर्ष आयोजित किया जाना निर्धारित है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because Quad leaders announced at the Manila Summit that the inaugural Quad Business Leaders' Forum is scheduled for early 2027 to boost private-sector engagement.
• Option A is Incorrect because 2024 marked previous Quad summits and working group meetings.
• Option B is Incorrect because 2025 is not the designated year for this forum.
• Option C is Incorrect because 2026 precedes the scheduled launch date of early 2027.

national_questions.qe: Which district in India was declared as the country's first e-waste-free district after collecting over 97 metric tonnes of e-waste?
national_questions.qh: 97 मीट्रिक टन से अधिक ई-कचरा एकत्र करने के बाद किस जिले को भारत का पहला ई-कचरा मुक्त जिला घोषित किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Wayanad district in Kerala achieved the milestone of becoming India's first e-waste-free district by collecting 97.26 metric tonnes of electronic waste through a drive coordinated by Suchitwa Mission and Clean Kerala Company.
• Option B is Incorrect because Indore is famous for consistently ranking as India's cleanest city under Swachh Survekshan, but not as the first e-waste-free district.
• Option C is Incorrect because Alappuzha is recognized for its decentralized solid waste management model, not for being the first e-waste-free district.
• Option D is Incorrect because Shimla is a hill municipality focusing on plastic waste bans, not the first designated e-waste-free district.

national_questions.qe: In which Indian state was 'Glyphipterix brevimucronata', the first new sedge moth species recorded in India in nearly a century, recently discovered?
national_questions.qh: हाल ही में लगभग एक शताब्दी में भारत में दर्ज की गई पहली नई सेज मथ (sedge moth) प्रजाति 'ग्लाइफिप्टेरिक्स ब्रेविमुक्रोनेटा' की खोज किस भारतीय राज्य में की गई?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Glyphipterix brevimucronata, a new species of sedge moth, was discovered near the Hollongapar Gibbon Sanctuary in the Jorhat district of Assam by ICAR-IARI scientist Kishore Chandra Sahoo.
• Option A is Incorrect because Arunachal Pradesh is famous for high butterfly biodiversity, but this specific discovery was made in Jorhat, Assam.
• Option C is Incorrect because Meghalaya features diverse micro-moths, but the study was conducted near Assam's Hollongapar Gibbon Sanctuary.
• Option D is Incorrect because Kerala's Western Ghats yield many amphibian species, whereas this insect species discovery occurred in Assam.

national_questions.qe: Which research institute developed India's first indigenous H5N1 bird flu vaccine for poultry?
national_questions.qh: पोल्ट्री के लिए भारत का पहला स्वदेशी H5N1 बर्ड फ्लू टीका किस अनुसंधान संस्थान द्वारा विकसित किया गया है?
oe: ICAR - National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD), Bhopal
oh: भारतीय पशु चिकित्सा अनुसंधान संस्थान (IVRI), बरेली
ICAR - राष्ट्रीय उच्च सुरक्षा पशु रोग संस्थान (NIHSAD), भोपाल
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because ICAR-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD), located in Bhopal, developed India's first indigenous H5N1 bird flu vaccine to safeguard the domestic poultry sector.
• Option A is Incorrect because IVRI Bareilly develops general livestock vaccines, but this specific H5N1 avian influenza vaccine was created at ICAR-NIHSAD Bhopal.
• Option B is Incorrect because NIV Pune primarily deals with human viral diseases such as COVID-19 and Dengue.
• Option D is Incorrect because CARI Izatnagar focuses on poultry genetics and management rather than bio-secure vaccine development.

national_questions.qe: What is the name of the female half-humanoid robot developed by ISRO to fly aboard the uncrewed test mission of India's Gaganyaan human spaceflight program?
national_questions.qh: भारत के गगनयान मानव अंतरिक्ष उड़ान कार्यक्रम के मानव रहित परीक्षण मिशन में उड़ान भरने के लिए इसरो (ISRO) द्वारा विकसित महिला हाफ-ह्यूमनॉइड रोबोट का नाम क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because Vyommitra is ISRO's female half-humanoid robot designed to perform life-support, environmental control, and panel control tasks during the uncrewed Gaganyaan (G1) orbital flight test.
• Option A is Incorrect because Mitra was an AI robot deployed at banking and retail events, not connected to ISRO's space missions.
• Option B is Incorrect because Roshni is an AI initiative name used in different social welfare domains.
• Option C is Incorrect because Shakti is the brand name for microprocessors developed by IIT Madras.

national_questions.qe: Which institute has developed India's first indigenous inactivated H5N1 bird flu vaccine for poultry?
national_questions.qh: पोल्ट्री के लिए भारत का पहला स्वदेशी निष्क्रिय H5N1 बर्ड फ्लू टीका किस संस्थान द्वारा विकसित किया गया है?
oe: ICAR - National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases, Bhopal
ICAR - Indian Veterinary Research Institute, Izatnagar
ICAR - Central Avian Research Institute, Izatnagar
oh: आईसीएआर - राष्ट्रीय उच्च सुरक्षा पशु रोग संस्थान, भोपाल
आईसीएआर - भारतीय पशु चिकित्सा अनुसंधान संस्थान, इज्जतनगर
आईसीएआर - केंद्रीय पक्षी अनुसंधान संस्थान, इज्जतनगर
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because ICAR-NIHSAD (National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases), Bhopal, developed India's first indigenous inactivated H5N1 bird flu vaccine for poultry to curb poultry mortality and mitigate economic losses.
• Option B is Incorrect because ICAR-IVRI is a prominent premier veterinary research institute in Izatnagar but did not develop this specific vaccine.
• Option C is Incorrect because NIV Pune primarily deals with human virology research.
• Option D is Incorrect because CARI focuses on general poultry management and breeding research.

national_questions.qe: India's first hydrogen production plant utilizing steel plant off-gases is being set up at which location?
national_questions.qh: स्टील प्लांट की ऑफ-गैसों का उपयोग करने वाला भारत का पहला हाइड्रोजन उत्पादन संयंत्र किस स्थान पर स्थापित किया जा रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because India's first hydrogen production facility using steel-plant off-gases is planned at Tata Steel's Kalinganagar integrated steelworks in Odisha, aiming to produce 10 tonnes of hydrogen per day for industrial decarbonisation.
• Option A is Incorrect because Bhilai is home to a major SAIL steel plant, but not this off-gas hydrogen project.
• Option C is Incorrect because Jamshedpur is Tata Steel's primary legacy unit, whereas Kalinganagar is the location chosen for this facility.
• Option D is Incorrect because Hazira is known for petrochemical and heavy manufacturing hubs rather than this project.

national_questions.qe: What was the name of India's first permanent research station established in Antarctica during the 1983–84 expedition?
national_questions.qh: वर्ष 1983-84 के अभियान के दौरान अंटार्कटिका में स्थापित भारत के पहले स्थायी अनुसंधान केंद्र का नाम क्या था?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Dakshin Gangotri was constructed during the 1983–84 summer season as India's first permanent scientific research station in Antarctica under the Indian Antarctic Programme.
• Option A is Incorrect because Maitri is India's second permanent Antarctic research station, set up in 1989.
• Option B is Incorrect because Bharati is India's third Antarctic research station, commissioned in 2012.
• Option D is Incorrect because Himadri is India's first Arctic research station, situated at Ny-Ålesund, Svalbard, Norway.

national_questions.qe: Where was India's first LED Dome planetarium inaugurated?
national_questions.qh: भारत के पहले एलईडी डोम प्लैनेटेरियम (तारामंडल) का उद्घाटन कहाँ किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because India's first LED Dome planetarium featuring advanced immersive displays was inaugurated at the Mysuru University campus in Mysuru, Karnataka.
• Option A is Incorrect because Bengaluru houses the Jawaharlal Nehru Planetarium, which uses traditional optical projections.
• Option B is Incorrect because Hyderabad is known for the BM Birla Planetarium.
• Option C is Incorrect because Gujarat's Science City in Ahmedabad features specialized theaters, but not India's first LED Dome planetarium.

national_questions.qe: Which industry body collaborated with the Ministry of Mines to launch the concept paper on 'Enabling Overseas Investment in Critical Minerals'?
national_questions.qh: क्रिटिकल मिनरल्स में विदेशी निवेश को सक्षम करने पर अवधारणा पत्र जारी करने के लिए खान मंत्रालय ने किस औद्योगिक संगठन के साथ सहयोग किया?
oe: Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry (FICCI)
Associated Chambers of Commerce and Industry of India (ASSOCHAM)
oh: एसोसिएटेड चैम्बर्स ऑफ कॉमर्स एंड इंडस्ट्री ऑफ इंडिया (ASSOCHAM)
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Ministry of Mines collaborated with FICCI to launch the concept paper titled 'Enabling Overseas Investment in Critical Minerals: Policy, Financial and Institutional Framework for Securing India's Critical Mineral Supply Chains'.
• Option B is Incorrect because CII was not the partner organization for this specific concept paper launch.
• Option C is Incorrect because ASSOCHAM was not involved in releasing this policy framework.
• Option D is Incorrect because NITI Aayog is a policy think tank, whereas the framework was jointly developed with FICCI.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian private defense manufacturer built and delivered the catamaran-hull Diving Support Craft 'DSC A21' to the Indian Navy?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय नौसेना को कैटमारन-हूल वाला डाइविंग सपोर्ट क्राफ्ट 'DSC A21' किस भारतीय रक्षा निर्माता द्वारा निर्मित कर सौंपा गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because 'DSC A21' was indigenously designed and constructed by Kolkata-based Titagarh Rail Systems Limited (TRSL) under the Diving Support Craft project for the Indian Navy.
• Option A is Incorrect because Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders is based in Mumbai and constructs major warships and submarines.
• Option C is Incorrect because GRSE was not the builder for this specific craft.
• Option D is Incorrect because Cochin Shipyard constructs larger sea vessels including aircraft carriers.

national_questions.qe: What is the name of the joint enforcement operation executed by India's NCB and the US DEA against a transnational illicit drug network?
national_questions.qh: भारत के एनसीबी (NCB) और अमेरिकी डीईए (DEA) द्वारा एक अंतरराष्ट्रीय अवैध मादक पदार्थ नेटवर्क के खिलाफ चलाए गए संयुक्त प्रवर्तन अभियान का क्या नाम है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because 'Operation Monsoon Thunder' was a joint action executed by India's Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) and the US Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) targeting transnational drug trafficking across digital platforms.
• Option A is Incorrect because Operation Garuda was led by CBI to disrupt global illicit drug networks with Interpol support.
• Option B is Incorrect because Operation Samudragupt was launched by NCB against maritime drug syndicates in the Indian Ocean.
• Option D is Incorrect because Operation Chakra was a CBI crackdown on cyber-enabled financial crimes.

national_questions.qe: In which country is the historic Ateshgah Fire Temple located, noted for its ancient Devanagari and Gurmukhi inscriptions reflecting cultural links with India?
national_questions.qh: ऐतिहासिक आतिशगाह अग्नि मंदिर किस देश में स्थित है, जो भारत के साथ सांस्कृतिक संबंधों को दर्शाने वाले अपने प्राचीन देवनागरी और गुरुमुखी शिलालेखों के लिए जाना जाता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the historic Ateshgah Fire Temple is located near Baku, Azerbaijan, and features preserved Devanagari and Gurmukhi inscriptions.
• Option A is Incorrect because Tajikistan was highlighted during the SCO forum for its 'Sumanak' Intangible Cultural Heritage, not the Ateshgah Temple.
• Option B is Incorrect because Uzbekistan does not house this specific temple.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ateshgah Temple is situated in Surakhani near Baku, Azerbaijan.

national_questions.qe: In which city was the official revival of the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue (Quad) foreign official-level talks held in 2017?
national_questions.qh: वर्ष 2017 में किस शहर में चतुर्भुज सुरक्षा संवाद (Quad) के विदेशी अधिकारी-स्तरीय वार्ता की आधिकारिक बहाली हुई थी?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Manila hosted the official revival of the Quad dialogue at the foreign officials' level in 2017, following the initial official-level meeting in the same city in 2007.
• Option A is Incorrect because Tokyo hosted several Quad ministerial and leaders' summits, but not the 2017 revival meeting.
• Option C is Incorrect because Canberra is the capital of Australia, a Quad member, but was not the venue for the 2017 revival.
• Option D is Incorrect because New Delhi has hosted Quad foreign ministers' meetings but not the landmark 2017 revival session.

national_questions.qe: Which feature film was chosen as India's official entry in the dedicated 'Films from BRICS' section at the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI)?
national_questions.qh: 57वें भारतीय अंतर्राष्ट्रीय फिल्म महोत्सव (IFFI) में विशेष रूप से क्यूरेटेड 'ब्रिक्स की फिल्में' खंड में भारत की आधिकारिक प्रविष्टि के रूप में किस फीचर फिल्म को चुना गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the film 'Article 370', directed by Aditya Dhar, was chosen as India's official entry in the 'Films from BRICS' curated section at the 57th IFFI in Goa.
• Option B is Incorrect because 'The Kerala Story' was not selected for this specific BRICS curated section.
• Option C is Incorrect because 'Sardar Udham' was featured in previous national awards, not as the 57th IFFI BRICS entry.
• Option D is Incorrect because 'RRR' achieved international accolades earlier but is not India's official entry for this 57th IFFI showcase.

national_questions.qe: Which municipal body launched 'CivitTwin', India's first AI-powered system for automated pre-scrutiny of building permit proposals?
national_questions.qh: भवन निर्माण अनुमति प्रस्तावों की स्वचालित पूर्व-जांच के लिए भारत की पहली AI-संचालित प्रणाली 'सिविटट्विन' (CivitTwin) की शुरुआत किस नगर निकाय द्वारा की गई है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) in Mumbai launched CivitTwin, India's first AI-powered system for virtual pre-scrutiny of building permit proposals.
• Option A is Incorrect because Greater Chennai Corporation has not launched the CivitTwin platform.
• Option B is Incorrect because BBMP in Bengaluru operates separate online building plan sanction tools, not CivitTwin.
• Option D is Incorrect because Municipal Corporation of Delhi uses the online building plan approval system (OBPAS), not CivitTwin.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian state has partnered with Amagi Media Labs to establish the country's first government-backed Sports Technology Centre of Excellence in Bengaluru?
national_questions.qh: किस भारतीय राज्य ने बेंगलुरु में देश के पहले सरकारी खेल प्रौद्योगिकी उत्कृष्टता केंद्र (Sports Technology CoE) की स्थापना के लिए अमागी मीडिया लैब्स के साथ साझेदारी की है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: Karnataka has announced the establishment of India's first government-backed Sports Technology Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Bengaluru in partnership with Amagi Media Labs.
• Option A is Incorrect: Tamil Nadu is developing sports infrastructure but is not setting up this specific Sports Tech CoE.
• Option C is Incorrect: Telangana has key IT initiatives, but this government sports tech centre is based in Bengaluru, Karnataka.
• Option D is Incorrect: Odisha is a major hub for sports hosting and infrastructure, but the first Sports Technology CoE is situated in Bengaluru.

national_questions.qe: Which national cybercrime helpline number is being actively promoted through India's first government-led microdrama series launched jointly by the Ministry of I&B, SEBI, and I4C?
national_questions.qh: सूचना एवं प्रसारण मंत्रालय, सेबी (SEBI) तथा I4C द्वारा संयुक्त रूप से शुरू की गई भारत की पहली माइक्रोड्रामा श्रृंखला के माध्यम से किस राष्ट्रीय साइबर अपराध हेल्पलाइन नंबर का प्रचार किया जा रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: The Ministry of Information & Broadcasting, Prasar Bharati, SEBI, and Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) jointly launched India's first government-led microdrama series to spread awareness about digital scams and promote the national cybercrime helpline 1930.
• Option A is Incorrect: Helpline 1033 is dedicated to National Highway emergency and roadside assistance.
• Option B is Incorrect: Helpline 112 is India's all-in-one emergency response support system (ERSS).
• Option D is Incorrect: Helpline 14440 is associated with financial and banking guidance, not the dedicated cybercrime financial fraud reporting line.

national_questions.qe: At which toll plaza on National Highway 48 did the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) launch its barrier-free Multi-Lane Free Flow (MLFF) tolling system?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग प्राधिकरण (NHAI) ने किस टोल प्लाजा पर राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग-48 (NH-48) पर अपनी बाधा-रहित मल्टी-लेन फ्री फ्लो (MLFF) टोलिंग प्रणाली का शुभारंभ किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: NHAI activated the Multi-Lane Free Flow (MLFF) barrier-free tolling system at Chennasamudram Plaza on NH-48 in Tamil Nadu using FASTag RFID and ANPR cameras.
• Option A is Incorrect: Kherki Daula Toll Plaza is located on NH-48 in Haryana.
• Option B is Incorrect: Paliekkara Toll Plaza is located in Kerala.
• Option D is Incorrect: Choryasi Toll Plaza is located in Gujarat.

national_questions.qe: In which state was the 12th Battalion campus of the National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) recently inaugurated at Hollongi?
national_questions.qh: हाल ही में होलोंगी में राष्ट्रीय आपदा मोचन बल (NDRF) के 12वें बटालियन परिसर का उद्घाटन किस राज्य में किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct: Union Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated the 12th NDRF Battalion campus at Hollongi near Itanagar in Arunachal Pradesh to strengthen disaster response infrastructure in the Northeast.
• Option A is Incorrect: Assam hosts other regional NDRF assets but not this specific 12th battalion campus.
• Option B is Incorrect: Sikkim is a neighboring northeastern state.
• Option C is Incorrect: Nagaland is also located in the Northeast region.

national_questions.qe: Which State is associated with the 'Mission Arun Himveer' initiative designed to empower local border villages to meet the operational needs of security forces?
national_questions.qh: सुरक्षा बलों की परिचालन आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करने के लिए स्थानीय सीमावर्ती गांवों को सशक्त बनाने के उद्देश्य से शुरू की गई 'मिशन अरुण हिमवीर' पहल किस राज्य से संबंधित है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because 'Mission Arun Himveer' and 'Mission Krishi Veer' were highlighted during the border security review in Itanagar, Arunachal Pradesh, to enable local border villages to supply fresh produce and operational support to security forces along the 1,126-km border.
• Option A is Incorrect because Ladakh is governed under separate border infrastructure development plans.
• Option C is Incorrect because Sikkim shares a border with China but is not the target state for Mission Arun Himveer.
• Option D is Incorrect because Uttarakhand is covered under the general Vibrant Villages Programme rollout.

national_questions.qe: Which AI-powered language platform developed by MeitY has been expanded to convert spoken clinical notes into electronic records across major public hospitals like AIIMS?
national_questions.qh: इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स और सूचना प्रौद्योगिकी मंत्रालय (MeitY) द्वारा विकसित कौन सा AI-संचालित भाषा प्लेटफॉर्म एम्स जैसे प्रमुख सार्वजनिक अस्पतालों में बोले गए नैदानिक नोट्स को इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रिकॉर्ड में बदलने के लिए विस्तारित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Bhashini, MeitY's AI language platform, expanded its speech-to-text voice prescription tool across AIIMS New Delhi and integrated it with hospital management modules like eHospital and e-Sushrut.
• Option B is Incorrect because Anuvadini is an AI translation tool developed primarily under AICTE for educational content.
• Option C is Incorrect because Samarth is an e-Governance portal for higher education institutions.
• Option D is Incorrect because MeghRaj is the Government of India's GI Cloud initiative.

national_questions.qe: Which historic institution, established in 1951 as India's very first Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), celebrated its Platinum Jubilee in 2026?
national_questions.qh: वर्ष 1951 में भारत के पहले भारतीय प्रौद्योगिकी संस्थान (IIT) के रूप में स्थापित किस ऐतिहासिक संस्थान ने 2026 में अपनी प्लैटिनम जयंती (75वाँ वर्ष) मनाई?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because IIT Kharagpur was established in 1951 as India's first IIT and celebrated its Platinum Jubilee (75th year) with the participation of Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
• Option A is Incorrect because IIT Bombay was established later in 1958.
• Option B is Incorrect because IIT Delhi was established in 1961.
• Option C is Incorrect because IIT Madras was established in 1959.

national_questions.qe: In which year was the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry (FICCI), India's premier apex business organization, established?
national_questions.qh: भारत के प्रमुख शीर्ष व्यापारिक संगठन 'भारतीय वाणिज्य एवं उद्योग महासंघ' (FICCI) की स्थापना किस वर्ष की गई थी?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because FICCI was established in 1927 on the advice of Mahatma Gandhi by G.D. Birla and Purshottamdas Thakurdas, celebrating its centenary convention.
• Option A is Incorrect because 1919 marks the founding year of the Associated Chambers of Commerce and Industry of India (ASSOCHAM).
• Option B is Incorrect because 1920 is associated with early trade union federations such as the All India Trade Union Congress (AITUC).
• Option D is Incorrect because 1935 marks the enactment of the Reserve Bank of India Act operationalization.

national_questions.qe: In which region is India's first commercial pilot geothermal power project being commissioned by the ONGC Energy Centre?
national_questions.qh: ओएनजीसी (ONGC) एनर्जी सेंटर द्वारा भारत की पहली व्यावसायिक पायलट भू-तापीय (जियोथर्मल) ऊर्जा परियोजना किस क्षेत्र में स्थापित की जा रही है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because India's first geothermal energy pilot project and geothermal wells are being commissioned at Puga Valley in Ladakh by the ONGC Energy Centre under the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy's policy framework.
• Option B is Incorrect because Manikaran in Himachal Pradesh is a prominent geothermal spring region, but not the site of India's first geothermal pilot wells by ONGC.
• Option C is Incorrect because Tattapani in Chhattisgarh is an identified geothermal site in central India, but not the pilot project site in question.
• Option D is Incorrect because Bakreshwar in West Bengal is known for geothermal springs but is not part of this landmark ONGC project.

national_questions.qe: Which Odisha-based institution established 'VSLV', recognized as India's first student rocketry team that launched multiple sounding rockets?
national_questions.qh: ओडिशा स्थित किस संस्थान ने भारत की पहली छात्र रॉकेटरी टीम 'VSLV' की स्थापना की, जिसने कई साउंडिंग रॉकेट सफलतापूर्वक लॉन्च किए?
oe: Veer Surendra Sai University of Technology (VSSUT), Odisha
Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology (KIIT), Bhubaneswar
oh: वीर सुरेंद्र साई प्रौद्योगिकी विश्वविद्यालय (VSSUT), ओडिशा
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because VSLV (VSSUT Satellite Launch Vehicle) was founded by students of Veer Surendra Sai University of Technology (VSSUT) in Burla, Odisha, making it India's first student rocketry team. Its alumni later founded deep-tech startup SpaceFields.
• Option A is Incorrect because NIT Rourkela is a premier technical institute in Odisha, but was not the institution behind VSLV.
• Option C is Incorrect because KIIT Bhubaneswar is a private deemed university and was not involved in founding the VSLV team.
• Option D is Incorrect because IIT Bhubaneswar is a central institute and not the origin institution of VSLV.

national_questions.qe: Which section of the Mumbai–Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail corridor became the first stretch of India's bullet train project to achieve electrification?
national_questions.qh: मुंबई-अहमदाबाद हाई-स्पीड रेल कॉरिडोर का कौन सा खंड भारत की बुलेट ट्रेन परियोजना का पहला विद्युतीकृत खंड बना?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the 50-km Surat–Bilimora section of the Mumbai–Ahmedabad High Speed Rail (MAHSR) corridor achieved electrification using a 2×25 kV overhead traction system, executed by the National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited (NHSRCL).
• Option B is Incorrect because the electrification milestone specifically commenced on the Surat–Bilimora section, not the Ahmedabad–Vapi section.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Vadodara–Anand stretch is a different civil package on the bullet train corridor.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Mumbai–Thane section involves undersea tunneling and terminal construction, not the initial electrification phase.

national_questions.qe: Which district became the first in India to complete 100% coverage of Digital Holistic Progress Cards for school students under the PARAKH portal initiative?
national_questions.qh: परख (PARAKH) पोर्टल पहल के तहत स्कूली छात्रों के लिए डिजिटल समग्र प्रगति कार्ड (Digital Holistic Progress Cards) का 100% कवरेज पूरा करने वाला भारत का पहला जिला कौन सा बना?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Anantnag district in Jammu & Kashmir became the first district in India to complete over 157,000 Digital Holistic Progress Cards covering government and private schools under the Ministry of Education's PARAKH portal.
• Option A is Incorrect because Wayanad achieved milestones in basic digital literacy and tribal document digitization, not the PARAKH progress cards.
• Option B is Incorrect because Indore is recognized for urban cleanliness drives and smart governance, not this education assessment rollout.
• Option D is Incorrect because Shimla was not the pioneering district for the Digital Holistic Progress Card initiative.

national_questions.qe: The 1,200 MW Kalai-II Hydroelectric Project, which recently received government clearance, is proposed to be constructed on which of the following rivers in Arunachal Pradesh?
national_questions.qh: 1,200 मेगावाट की कलाई-II जलविद्युत परियोजना, जिसे हाल ही में सरकारी मंजूरी प्राप्त हुई है, अरुणाचल प्रदेश में निम्नलिखित में से किस नदी पर निर्मित करने का प्रस्ताव है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the 1,200 MW Kalai-II Hydroelectric Project is proposed to be executed on the Lohit River in the Anjaw district of Arunachal Pradesh as a joint venture between THDC India Limited and the State Government.
• Option A is Incorrect because the project is not situated on the Dibang River.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Subansiri River hosts other projects like the Subansiri Lower Hydroelectric Project.
• Option D is Incorrect because Kameng River is home to the Kameng Hydroelectric Project.

national_questions.qe: The documentary film 'Naqsh-e-Daur', screened at the International Film Festival of India (IFFI), showcases the life and master craftsmanship of Padma Shri awardee Ghulam Nabi Dar in which traditional art form?
national_questions.qh: इंटरनेशनल फिल्म फेस्टिवल ऑफ इंडिया (IFFI) में प्रदर्शित वृत्तचित्र फिल्म 'नक्श-ए-दौर', किस पारंपरिक कला में पद्म श्री पुरस्कार विजेता गुलाम नबी डार के जीवन और उत्कृष्ट शिल्प कौशल को दर्शाती है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because 'Naqsh-e-Daur', directed by Baba Tasadduq Hussain, highlights Kashmir's rich heritage of traditional woodcarving through the craftsmanship of Padma Shri awardee Ghulam Nabi Dar.
• Option B is Incorrect because Channapatna woodcraft is a GI-tagged traditional craft from Karnataka.
• Option C is Incorrect because Sankheda furniture craft belongs to Gujarat.
• Option D is Incorrect because Saharanpur wood carving is a celebrated craft from Uttar Pradesh.

national_questions.qe: With which West African country has India agreed to collaborate on medicinal plant conservation and traditional medicine standardisation through the National Medicinal Plants Board?
national_questions.qh: भारत ने राष्ट्रीय औषधीय पादप बोर्ड के माध्यम से औषधीय पौधों के संरक्षण और पारंपरिक चिकित्सा के मानकीकरण पर किस पश्चिमी अफ़्रीकी देश के साथ सहयोग करने पर सहमति व्यक्त की है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: Union Minister for Ayush Prataprao Jadhav held bilateral talks with Burkina Faso in New Delhi to collaborate on medicinal plant conservation, standardisation of herbal medicines, and Yoga through India's National Medicinal Plants Board under South-South Cooperation.
• Option A is Incorrect: Ghana was not part of this bilateral agreement on traditional medicine.
• Option C is Incorrect: Senegal was not involved in this Ayush partnership initiative.
• Option D is Incorrect: Nigeria was not the bilateral partner for this National Medicinal Plants Board initiative.

national_questions.qe: The Ministry of Ayush approved the establishment of the second campus of the National Institute of Unani Medicine (NIUM) featuring a 200-bed referral hospital in which city?
national_questions.qh: आयुष मंत्रालय ने 200 बिस्तरों वाले रेफरल अस्पताल से युक्त राष्ट्रीय यूनानी चिकित्सा संस्थान (NIUM) के दूसरे परिसर की स्थापना को किस शहर में मंजूरी दी है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: Union Minister of State for Ayush Prataprao Jadhav chaired the 13th Governing Body meeting of NIUM, approving a second campus in Ghaziabad (Uttar Pradesh) equipped with a 200-bed referral hospital and five new postgraduate departments.
• Option B is Incorrect: Lucknow is not the location chosen for the new NIUM second campus.
• Option C is Incorrect: Bhopal hosts the All India Institute of Ayurveda branch, not the new NIUM second campus.
• Option D is Incorrect: Hyderabad was not selected for this NIUM extension campus.

national_questions.qe: Where was the 'Raisina Tokyo 2026' conference held to strengthen bilateral cooperation in semiconductors, critical minerals, and defence?
national_questions.qh: सेमीकंडक्टर, महत्वपूर्ण खनिज और रक्षा क्षेत्र में द्विपक्षीय सहयोग को मजबूत करने के लिए 'रायसीना टोक्यो 2026' सम्मेलन कहाँ आयोजित किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct: External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar addressed Raisina Tokyo 2026 in Tokyo, Japan, highlighting bilateral cooperation across critical minerals, clean energy, semiconductors, and defence within the Quad framework.
• Option A is Incorrect: New Delhi hosts the primary annual Raisina Dialogue, but this outreach event was held in Tokyo.
• Option B is Incorrect: Canberra is in Australia and did not host this dialogue.
• Option C is Incorrect: Singapore did not host this Raisina Dialogue outreach edition.

national_questions.qe: Under the Special Campaign 6.0 for cleanliness and administrative efficiency, a zero-cost scrap structure named 'Gaj-Garuda' was installed at the Income Tax Office in which city?
national_questions.qh: स्वच्छता और प्रशासनिक दक्षता के लिए 'विशेष अभियान 6.0' के तहत, किस शहर के आयकर कार्यालय में 'गज-गरुड़' नामक शून्य-लागत स्क्रैप संरचना स्थापित की गई?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: As part of CBDT's Special Campaign 6.0 implementation, a zero-cost 'Waste to Art' structure named 'Gaj-Garuda', crafted from discarded scrap metal, was installed at the Income Tax Office in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.
• Option A is Incorrect: Ranchi Income Tax Office was not the site of the Gaj-Garuda scrap installation.
• Option B is Incorrect: Patna was not where this zero-cost structure was erected.
• Option D is Incorrect: Cuttack was not the site of this specific initiative.

national_questions.qe: Which seaport is being developed under 'Mission Samudra' to establish India's first outer service port, modeled on UAE's Fujairah port?
national_questions.qh: संयुक्त अरब अमीरात (UAE) के फुजैराह पोर्ट की तर्ज पर 'मिशन समुद्र' के तहत भारत का पहला 'आउटर सर्विस पोर्ट' किस बंदरगाह पर विकसित किया जा रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Vizhinjam International Seaport in Kerala is being developed as India's first outer service port under 'Mission Samudra' by the Kerala Maritime Board, offering bunkering, repairs, maintenance, and crew changes modeled after UAE's Fujairah port.
• Option B is Incorrect because Deendayal Port (Kandla) is a major commercial cargo port in Gujarat, not the designated site for India's first outer service port.
• Option C is Incorrect because Vadhvan Port is an upcoming major deep-draft port in Maharashtra.
• Option D is Incorrect because Paradip Port is a major natural deep-water port located on the eastern coast in Odisha.

national_questions.qe: Which airline partnered with aircraft manufacturer Airbus to initiate a feasibility study for India’s first voluntary corporate Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) programme?
national_questions.qh: भारत के पहले स्वैच्छिक कॉर्पोरेट सस्टेनेबल एविएशन फ्यूल (SAF) कार्यक्रम का व्यवहार्यता अध्ययन करने के लिए विमान निर्माता एयरबस ने किस भारतीय एयरलाइन के साथ समझौता किया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Air India and Airbus signed an agreement to conduct a feasibility study for India's first voluntary corporate Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) programme to reduce lifecycle carbon emissions from business air travel.
• Option A is Incorrect because IndiGo is not the airline partner involved in this specific corporate SAF feasibility initiative with Airbus.
• Option C is Incorrect because SpiceJet is not associated with this partnership framework.
• Option D is Incorrect because Akasa Air is a newer domestic operator and is not a party to this agreement.

national_questions.qe: Gurdwara Ber Sahib, associated with Sri Guru Nanak Dev Ji's 15-year period of meditation, is located in which of the following historical places?
national_questions.qh: श्री गुरु नानक देव जी के 15 वर्षों की ध्यान साधना से जुड़ा ऐतिहासिक 'गुरुद्वारा बेर साहिब' निम्नलिखित में से किस स्थान पर स्थित है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Gurdwara Ber Sahib is situated in Sultanpur Lodhi (Punjab), where Sri Guru Nanak Dev Ji spent nearly 15 years of his life and meditated under a Ber (Jujube) tree before attaining enlightenment.
• Option A is Incorrect because Nankana Sahib (now in Pakistan) is the birthplace of Guru Nanak Dev Ji, born in 1469 at Rai Bhoi Ki Talwandi.
• Option C is Incorrect because Anandpur Sahib is associated with Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji and Sri Guru Gobind Singh Ji (founding of Khalsa Panth in 1699).
• Option D is Incorrect because Kartarpur Sahib (Pakistan) is the site where Guru Nanak Dev Ji spent the final years of his life and established the first Sikh commune.

national_questions.qe: The prestigious ICFT-UNESCO Gandhi Medal is annually presented at which of the following cultural events to honor films promoting Mahatma Gandhi's ideals of peace and non-violence?
national_questions.qh: महात्मा गांधी के शांति और अहिंसा के आदर्शों को बढ़ावा देने वाली फिल्मों को सम्मानित करने के लिए प्रतिष्ठित ICFT-UNESCO गांधी पदक किस वार्षिक आयोजन में प्रदान किया जाता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the ICFT-UNESCO Gandhi Medal is awarded annually at the International Film Festival of India (IFFI) in Goa to recognize films reflecting Mahatma Gandhi's vision of peace, tolerance, and intercultural harmony.
• Option B is Incorrect because MIFF primarily focuses on documentary, short, and animation films.
• Option C is Incorrect because the National Film Awards are India's principal national awards for Indian cinema presented by the Directorate of Film Festivals, separate from UNESCO's collaborative awards.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Dharamshala International Film Festival is an independent regional festival held in Himachal Pradesh.

national_questions.qe: Where was the National Organ Transplant Games 2026 inaugurated by the Vice President of India?
national_questions.qh: भारत के उपराष्ट्रपति द्वारा 'राष्ट्रीय अंग प्रत्यारोपण खेल 2026' का उद्घाटन कहाँ किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the National Organ Transplant Games 2026 was inaugurated by Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan at Talkatora Stadium in New Delhi.
• Option B is Incorrect because Bengaluru was not the host city for this edition.
• Option C is Incorrect because Hyderabad did not serve as the venue for this national event.
• Option D is Incorrect because Mumbai did not host the games or the associated world record assembly.

national_questions.qe: At which institution was India's first dedicated Quantum-AI university campus inaugurated by NIELIT?
national_questions.qh: NIELIT द्वारा भारत के पहले समर्पित 'क्वांटम-एआई विश्वविद्यालय परिसर' का उद्घाटन किस संस्थान में किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because India’s first dedicated Quantum-AI university campus was launched at Acharya Nagarjuna University in Guntur, Andhra Pradesh, established by NIELIT.
