• Option A is Incorrect because Andhra University in Visakhapatnam is not the location of this new Quantum-AI university campus.
• Option B is Incorrect because IIT Tirupati is not the host university for this project.
• Option D is Incorrect because NIT Tadepalligudem was not selected for this dedicated campus setting.

national_questions.qe: Which institution was involved in the discovery of 'Hypereteone indica', India's first new Hypereteone marine species identified in over 90 years?
national_questions.qh: 90 से अधिक वर्षों में भारत में खोजी गई पहली नई हाइपरइटीओन समुद्री प्रजाति 'हाइपरइटीओन इंडिका' (Hypereteone indica) की खोज में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा संस्थान शामिल था?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because scientists from the Zoological Survey of India (ZSI), alongside researchers from West Bengal State University and Federal University of Maranhão, discovered 'Hypereteone indica' from the Bay of Bengal along the Odisha and West Bengal coasts.
• Option B is Incorrect because NIO was not involved in the taxonomic description of this new marine polychaete species.
• Option C is Incorrect because CMFRI focuses primarily on marine fisheries research rather than this taxonomic discovery.
• Option D is Incorrect because BSI deals exclusively with plant flora classification.

national_questions.qe: India's first indigenous inactivated H5N1 avian influenza vaccine targeting Clade 2.3.2.1a has been developed by which research institute?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला स्वदेशी निष्क्रिय H5N1 एवियन इन्फ्लूएंजा टीका (क्लेड 2.3.2.1a को लक्षित करने वाला) किस अनुसंधान संस्थान द्वारा विकसित किया गया है?
oe: ICAR - Indian Veterinary Research Institute (IVRI), Bareilly
ICAR - National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD), Bhopal
ICMR - National Institute of Virology (NIV), Pune
CSIR - Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB), Hyderabad
oh: ICAR - भारतीय पशु चिकित्सा अनुसंधान संस्थान (IVRI), बरेली
ICAR - राष्ट्रीय उच्च सुरक्षा पशु रोग संस्थान (NIHSAD), भोपाल
ICMR - राष्ट्रीय विषाणु विज्ञान संस्थान (NIV), पुणे
CSIR - कोशिकीय एवं आणविक जीवविज्ञान केंद्र (CCMB), हैदराबाद
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because ICAR-NIHSAD, Bhopal developed India's first indigenous inactivated H5N1 avian influenza vaccine targeting Clade 2.3.2.1a to protect poultry and control economic losses.
• Option A is Incorrect because IVRI Bareilly did not develop this specific H5N1 variant vaccine.
• Option C is Incorrect because ICMR-NIV focuses primarily on human viral pathogens.
• Option D is Incorrect because CCMB focuses on cellular and molecular biology research.

national_questions.qe: On which specific section of the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail corridor are the initial trial runs of India's first bullet train scheduled to take place?
national_questions.qh: भारत की पहली बुलेट ट्रेन का प्रारंभिक परीक्षण मुंबई-अहमदाबाद हाई-स्पीड रेल कॉरिडोर के किस विशिष्ट खंड पर आयोजित किया जाना निर्धारित है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the inaugural trial runs for India's bullet train will be conducted on the 50-km Surat-Bilimora stretch of the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail corridor using the B-28 train capable of 280 km/h speeds.
• Option A is Incorrect because the trial operations are not scheduled on the Ahmedabad-Vadodara stretch during the initial trial phase.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Mumbai-Thane section features complex undersea tunnels and is planned for a later phase.
• Option D is Incorrect because Vapi-Bharuch is not the selected 50-km trial section.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian commercial vehicle manufacturer has flagged off India's first completely indigenous bullet- and blast-resistant Armoured Troop Transporters (ATT) for the CRPF and BSF?
national_questions.qh: किस भारतीय वाणिज्यिक वाहन निर्माता ने CRPF और BSF के लिए भारत के पहले पूरी तरह से स्वदेशी बुलेट और ब्लास्ट-प्रतिरोधी बख्तरबंद सैनिक परिवहन वाहनों (ATT) को हरी झंडी दिखाई है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because Ashok Leyland built and flagged off India's first indigenous 28-seater Armoured Troop Transporters (ATT) under a ₹187.24 crore Ministry of Home Affairs contract for CRPF and BSF.
• Option A is Incorrect because Tata Motors did not build this specific 28-seater ATT platform.
• Option B is Incorrect because Mahindra Defence Systems manufactures light specialist tactical vehicles rather than this heavy ATT fleet.
• Option C is Incorrect because Bharat Forge primarily manufactures artillery guns and specialized defence hardware.

national_questions.qe: The 'Team Mountain Eagles' demonstration of landing microlight aircraft on NH-754K was coordinated with which agency?
national_questions.qh: 'टीम माउंटेन ईगल्स' द्वारा NH-754K पर माइक्रोलाइट विमान लैंडिंग प्रदर्शन किस एजेंसी के समन्वय से किया गया था?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the operation was executed in coordination with the National Highways Authority of India, which manages the highway used as an emergency landing strip.
• Option A is Incorrect; the Indian Air Force was not involved in this army‑led aero‑adventure exercise.
• Option B is Incorrect as the Ministry of Defence oversaw the mission but the specific coordinating agency for the highway was NHAI.
• Option D is Incorrect because law‑enforcement agencies were not responsible for the landing coordination.

national_questions.qe: According to the provisional Service Producer Price Index (SPPI) data for Q2 FY 2025-26, what was the annual inflation rate for air passenger services?
national_questions.qh: प्रोविज़नल सर्विस प्रोड्यूसर प्राइस इंडेक्स (SPPI) के Q2 FY 2025-26 डेटा के अनुसार, हवाई यात्री सेवाओं की वार्षिक महंगाई दर क्या थी?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the provisional SPPIs released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry recorded air passenger service inflation at 35.52% YoY in Q2.
• Option A is Incorrect; this figure does not match the reported data.
• Option B is Incorrect; the inflation rate was significantly higher than 22.78%.
• Option C is Incorrect; 28.90% is lower than the actual 35.52% reported.

national_questions.qe: What is the maximum percentage of sale value that can be paid early to Farmer Producer Organisations under the SEBI‑proposed framework for agricultural commodity derivatives?
national_questions.qh: सेबी द्वारा प्रस्तावित कृषि वस्तु डेरिवेटिव्स में किसान उत्पादक संगठनों को अधिकतम कितने प्रतिशत बिक्री मूल्य की अग्रिम भुगतान की अनुमति है?
oe: Up to 80% of the sale value
Up to 70% of the sale value
Up to 60% of the sale value
Up to 50% of the sale value
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because SEBI’s early‑pay‑out framework allows Farmer Producer Organisations to receive up to 80% of the sale value before the commodity is sold from the warehouse.
• Option B is Incorrect because the framework does not mention a 70% limit.
• Option C is Incorrect as 60% is not the stipulated ceiling.
• Option D is Incorrect; 50% is lower than the approved maximum.

national_questions.qe: Under the Joint Vision Document announced during the Nepal Prime Minister's state visit, which new rail service was launched connecting Ayodhya in India with Janakpur in Nepal?
national_questions.qh: नेपाल के प्रधानमंत्री की भारत यात्रा के दौरान जारी संयुक्त विज़न दस्तावेज़ के तहत आयोध्या (भारत) और जनकपुर (नेपाल) को जोड़ने वाली नई रेल सेवा का नाम क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the joint vision announced the Sarayu‑Kamala Express rail service linking Ayodhya and Janakpur.
• Option A is Incorrect; Mahakali Express was not part of the announced projects.
• Option C is Incorrect; Ganga‑Darjeeling Express is unrelated to the India‑Nepal connectivity plan.
• Option D is Incorrect; Brahmaputra Express pertains to a different corridor.

national_questions.qe: Which sector did Defence Minister Rajnath Singh emphasize for building indigenous capabilities to reduce import dependence, as highlighted at the 36th Annual Conference on Non‑Destructive Evaluation?
national_questions.qh: 36वें वार्षिक गैर‑ध्वंसात्मक मूल्यांकन सम्मेलन में रक्षा मंत्री राजनाथ सिंह ने आयात निर्भरता कम करने के लिए किस क्षेत्र में स्वदेशी क्षमताओं के निर्माण पर ज़ोर दिया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the minister called for indigenous development of Non‑Destructive Testing (NDT) equipment, sensors and software to cut import reliance.
• Option A is Incorrect; propulsion systems were not the focus of the speech.
• Option B is Incorrect; satellite communication was mentioned elsewhere but not as the primary NDT call.
• Option D is Incorrect; cybersecurity, while important, was not highlighted in this specific conference.

national_questions.qe: Under which Indian agency's contract is the first fully industry‑manufactured PSLV being developed, and in which quarter of which year is its maiden launch scheduled?
national_questions.qh: न्यूस्पेस इंडिया लिमिटेड के अनुबंध के तहत विकसित पहला पूर्णतः उद्योग‑निर्मित PSLV किस तिमाही और वर्ष में प्रथम बार प्रक्षेपित होने की योजना है?
national_questions.e: • Option B is Correct because the contract for the first fully industry‑manufactured PSLV (PSLV‑N1) was awarded to NewSpace India Limited (NSIL) and the launch is slated for the first quarter of 2027. • Option A is Incorrect because ISRO is not the contracting agency for this private‑sector project and the year is wrong. • Option C is Incorrect because the Department of Space is the parent ministry, not the contracting entity, and the quarter/year do not match. • Option D is Incorrect because Hindustan Aeronautics Limited is a manufacturing partner, not the contracting agency, and the timeline is inaccurate.

national_questions.qe: What is the primary scientific objective of India's XpoSat satellite launched by ISRO?
national_questions.qh: ISRO द्वारा प्रक्षेपित भारत के XpoSat उपग्रह का मुख्य वैज्ञानिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
oe: Observing X‑ray polarization from cosmic sources
oh: ब्रह्मांडीय स्रोतों से X‑रे ध्रुवीकरण का निरीक्षण
पृथ्वी के चुंबकीय क्षेत्र का मानचित्रण
national_questions.e: • Option B is Correct because XpoSat is India's first X‑ray polarimeter satellite, intended to measure the polarization of X‑ray emissions from astrophysical objects such as black holes. • Option A is Incorrect; solar flare studies are carried out by dedicated solar missions. • Option C is Incorrect; magnetic field mapping is the purpose of missions like Swarm. • Option D is Incorrect; L‑band communication testing is not the mission goal of XpoSat.

national_questions.qe: Which DRDO‑contracted technology provides a secure high‑speed two‑way data link between ground stations and drones using free‑space optical terminals?
national_questions.qh: DRDO अनुबंध के तहत विकसित कौन सी तकनीक मुक्त‑स्थान ऑप्टिकल टर्मिनलों का उपयोग करके ग्राउंड स्टेशन और ड्रोन के बीच सुरक्षित उच्च‑गति दो‑तरफ़ा डेटा लिंक प्रदान करती है?
national_questions.e: • Option B is Correct because the first laser‑link drone communication system developed under a DRDO contract uses free‑space optical terminals with automatic PAT to deliver secure, high‑speed two‑way links. • Option A is Incorrect; satellite RF links are not the technology described. • Option C is Incorrect; 5G cellular links are terrestrial RF solutions, not free‑space optics. • Option D is Incorrect; LoRaWAN is a low‑power wide‑area network, not suitable for high‑speed drone data transfer.

national_questions.qe: In November 2024, the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approved the development of a new Greenfield Airport at Doloo in which state?
national_questions.qh: नवंबर 2024 में, आर्थिक मामलों की कैबिनेट समिति ने किस राज्य के डोलो में एक नए ग्रीनफील्ड हवाई अड्डे के विकास को मंजूरी दी?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) approved the development of a new Greenfield Airport at Doloo, Silchar in Cachar district of Assam at an estimated cost of ₹2,014 crore.
• Option B is Incorrect: Arunachal Pradesh is not the host state for the Doloo airport project.
• Option C is Incorrect: Meghalaya is not associated with the Doloo Greenfield Airport development.
• Option D is Incorrect: Tripura is not the site of this newly approved greenfield project.

national_questions.qe: Under the IndiaAI Mission, which Union Ministry launched the indigenous 'Chariot-1' foundation AI models?
national_questions.qh: 'इंडिया-एआई मिशन' के तहत किस केंद्रीय मंत्रालय द्वारा स्वदेशी 'चैरियट-1' (Chariot-1) फाउंडेशन एआई मॉडल लॉन्च किए गए?
oe: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) Secretary S Krishnan launched the indigenous Chariot-1 foundation AI models under the IndiaAI Mission.
• Option A is Incorrect: Ministry of Science and Technology is not the nodal ministry executing the IndiaAI Mission.
• Option C is Incorrect: Ministry of Education is not involved in launching the Chariot-1 AI foundation models.
• Option D is Incorrect: Ministry of Communications does not oversee the IndiaAI Mission framework.

national_questions.qe: Which country won the 'Best National Pavilion – Visitors’ Lion' award at the Venice Art Biennale?
national_questions.qh: वेनिस आर्ट बिएनाले में किस देश ने 'सर्वश्रेष्ठ राष्ट्रीय मंडप - विजिटर्स लायन' का पुरस्कार जीता?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: India won the 'Best National Pavilion – Visitors’ Lion' award at the Venice Art Biennale, decided through global public votes. The pavilion was commissioned by the National Gallery of Modern Art under the Ministry of Culture, with IGNCA as the executing agency.
• Option A is Incorrect: Japan did not win the Visitors' Lion award at this edition.
• Option B is Incorrect: Brazil was not the recipient of this public vote award.
• Option D is Incorrect: South Africa did not win the Best National Pavilion Visitors' Lion award.

national_questions.qe: Where was the 8th NSA-Level Meeting of the Colombo Security Conclave (CSC) held in November 2024?
national_questions.qh: नवंबर 2024 में कोलंबो सुरक्षा सम्मेलन (CSC) की 8वीं राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा सलाहकार (NSA) स्तरीय बैठक कहाँ आयोजित की गई थी?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct: The 8th National Security Advisors' Meeting of the Colombo Security Conclave (CSC) was held in Male, Maldives, and addressed by India's NSA Ajit Doval.
• Option A is Incorrect: Colombo hosted earlier sessions, but the 8th NSA meeting was hosted in Male.
• Option B is Incorrect: Port Louis is a member state location but was not the venue for this 8th NSA meeting.
• Option C is Incorrect: New Delhi was not the host city for the 8th NSA-level gathering of the conclave.

national_questions.qe: Under which Indian policy was the bilateral visit of Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah conducted?

bihar_questions.qe: Under the Tenth Schedule of the Indian Constitution, on which ground does an independently elected member of a Legislative Assembly or Council face disqualification?

bihar_questions.qe: Which NHAI Toll‑Operate‑Transfer (ToT) bundle in Bihar covers the 90.6 km Purnea‑Dalkhola‑Raiganj section of NH‑27?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में कौन सा NHAI टोल‑ऑपरेट‑ट्रांसफर (ToT) बंडल 90.6 किमी पर्निया‑डालखोला‑रायगंज सेक्शन को कवर करता है?
bihar_questions.e:

• Option B is Incorrect; Bundle 20 refers to the 145.6 km Muzaffarpur‑Darbhanga‑Asanpur section.
• Option C is Incorrect; Bundle 21 covers the 139.3 km Asanpur‑Forbesganj‑Purnea section.
• Option D is Incorrect; Bundle 19 is not mentioned in the bids.

bihar_questions.qe: In which year is the Global Convention on Transforming Bihar scheduled to be held in Patna?
bihar_questions.qh: ग्लोबल कॉन्फ़्रेंस ऑन ट्रांसफ़ॉर्मिंग बिहार किस वर्ष पटना में आयोजित होने के लिए निर्धारित है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the two‑day convention is slated for 12‑13 January 2027.
• Option A is Incorrect; 2025 is not the announced year.
• Option B is Incorrect; 2026 is not the announced year.
• Option D is Incorrect; 2028 is not the announced year.

bihar_questions.qe: The 19‑km six‑lane Kacchi Dargah‑Bidupur bridge over the Ganga connects which two districts in Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: गंगा पर 19 किमी लंबा छह‑लेन कच्ची दरगाह‑बिदुपुर पुल किन दो जिलों को जोड़ता है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the bridge links Kacchi Dargah in Patna district with Bidupur in Vaishali district.
• Option A is Incorrect; Saran district is not part of the alignment.
• Option C is Incorrect; Muzaffarpur district is not involved.
• Option D is Incorrect; Bhagalpur district is not involved.

bihar_questions.qe: How many BlazeX electric motorcycles did Revolt Motors agree to supply to the Bihar Police?
bihar_questions.qh: रिवोल्ट मोटर्स ने बिहार पुलिस को कितनी ब्लेज़एक्स इलेक्ट्रिक मोटरसाइकिलें सप्लाई करने का आदेश दिया?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the institutional order is for 1,100 BlazeX electric bikes.
• Option A is Incorrect; the order is not for 500 units.
• Option C is Incorrect; 2,000 units were not ordered.
• Option D is Incorrect; 1,500 units were not ordered.

bihar_questions.qe: Under the domestic electricity subsidy scheme in Bihar, how many units of subsidised power per month has the state government appealed to income tax payers to voluntarily surrender?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में घरेलू बिजली सब्सिडी योजना के तहत राज्य सरकार ने आयकर दाताओं से प्रति माह कितने यूनिट सब्सिडी वाली बिजली स्वेच्छा से छोड़ने की अपील की है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Bihar State Government spends approximately ₹23,000 crore annually on power subsidies and has appealed to affluent households and income tax payers to voluntarily surrender their entitlement to 125 units of free electricity.
• Option A is Incorrect because 100 units is not the target quantum specified in the Bihar state government's appeal.
• Option C is Incorrect because 150 units exceeds the monthly threshold designated under the subsidy appeal.
• Option D is Incorrect because 200 units is an incorrect limit.

bihar_questions.qe: Which city was conferred the 'State First Clean City' award for Bihar in the 10th edition of Swachh Survekshan?
bihar_questions.qh: स्वच्छ सर्वेक्षण के 10वें संस्करण में बिहार के किस शहर को 'राज्य प्रथम स्वच्छ शहर' (State First Clean City) पुरस्कार से सम्मानित किया गया?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Patna was conferred the 'State First Clean City' award for Bihar in the 10th edition of Swachh Survekshan by President Droupadi Murmu, recognizing the efforts of the Patna Municipal Corporation and public participation.
• Option B is Incorrect because Gaya did not secure the top clean city recognition in this edition.
• Option C is Incorrect because Muzaffarpur was not awarded the top state clean city rank in Swachh Survekshan.
• Option D is Incorrect because Bhagalpur did not win the primary state honor.

bihar_questions.qe: Under the standard guidelines governing Income Tax raids as clarified by the Supreme Court, what is the non-seizure threshold limit of gold jewelry permitted for a married woman?
bihar_questions.qh: आयकर छापे के दौरान सुप्रीम कोर्ट द्वारा स्पष्ट किए गए मानक दिशा-निर्देशों के तहत, एक शादीशुदा महिला के लिए सोने के आभूषण की जब्त न की जाने वाली सीमा कितनी है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because under Income Tax raid guidelines, the threshold for non-seizure of gold jewelry is 500 grams for a married woman, 250 grams for an unmarried woman, and 100 grams for a male member.
• Option A is Incorrect because 250 grams is the non-seizure threshold limit specified for unmarried women.
• Option C is Incorrect because 100 grams is the non-seizure threshold limit specified for male members.
• Option D is Incorrect because 1000 grams exceeds the permissible standard non-seizure threshold limit.

bihar_questions.qe: What is the official target timeframe for resolving public grievance applications under the 'Sahyog' programme initiative in Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में 'सहयोग' कार्यक्रम पहल के तहत जन शिकायत आवेदनों के निवारण की आधिकारिक निर्धारित समय सीमा क्या है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Sahyog Camp initiative in Bihar mandates the resolution of public grievance applications within a timeframe of 30 days.
• Option A is Incorrect because 15 days is not the stipulated timeframe for this initiative.
• Option B is Incorrect because 20 days is not the specified grievance resolution timeline.
• Option D is Incorrect because 60 days exceeds the official 30-day resolution deadline.

bihar_questions.qe: Which newly constructed river bridge over the Ganga River connects Patna with Vaishali district in Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: गंगा नदी पर निर्मित कौन सा नया नदी पुल बिहार में पटना को वैशाली जिले से जोड़ता है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: The six-lane Kacchi Dargah-Raghopur-Bidupur bridge over the Ganga River connects Patna to Vaishali district and spans 19.76 km including approach roads, officially named 'Nitish Setu'.
• Option B is Incorrect: Mahatma Gandhi Setu is an older existing bridge connecting Patna to Hajipur.
• Option C is Incorrect: Vikramshila Setu spans the Ganga near Bhagalpur.
• Option D is Incorrect: Digha-Arah Bridge connects Patna with Bhojpur district.

bihar_questions.qe: Under the phased tiger reintroduction programme supervised by NTCA, tigress T138 was translocated to West Bengal's Buxa Tiger Reserve from which tiger reserve of Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: एनटीसीए (NTCA) की देखरेख में चरणबद्ध बाघ पुनर्वसन कार्यक्रम के तहत, बाघिन T138 को बिहार के किस बाघ अभयारण्य से पश्चिम बंगाल के बक्सा टाइगर रिजर्व में स्थानांतरित किया गया?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: A three-year-old tigress (T138) was translocated from Bihar's Valmiki Tiger Reserve (VTR) in West Champaran to Buxa Tiger Reserve (BTR) in West Bengal as part of a joint tiger recovery initiative by NTCA, WII, and state authorities.
• Option A is Incorrect: Kaimur Wildlife Sanctuary is a proposed second tiger reserve in Bihar, not the source site.
• Option B is Incorrect: Bhimbandh Wildlife Sanctuary is located in Munger district.
• Option D is Incorrect: Gautam Buddha Wildlife Sanctuary is located in Gaya district.

bihar_questions.qe: Under its newly launched PPP-model scheme for sugarcane expansion, how many hi-tech sugarcane nurseries has the Bihar government decided to establish across the state?
bihar_questions.qh: गन्ना विस्तार की अपनी नई पीपीपी-मॉडल योजना के तहत, बिहार सरकार ने राज्य भर में कितनी हाई-टेक गन्ना नर्सरियां स्थापित करने का निर्णय लिया है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct: The Bihar Sugarcane Industries Department launched a scheme to establish 44 hi-tech sugarcane nurseries under a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model to produce 2.20 crore disease-free seedlings annually using single-bud plantlet technology, providing a 75% subsidy (up to ₹11.25 lakh per nursery).
• Option A is Incorrect: 25 is not the correct count.
• Option B is Incorrect: 36 is not the approved number.
• Option C is Incorrect: 52 is not the state target.

bihar_questions.qe: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA), which extended ceiling prices for orthopaedic knee implants until 2027, functions under which Union Ministry?
bihar_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय औषधि मूल्य निर्धारण प्राधिकरण (NPPA), जिसने ऑर्थोपेडिक घुटने के प्रत्यारोपण की अधिकतम कीमतों को 2027 तक बढ़ाया है, किस केंद्रीय मंत्रालय के अंतर्गत कार्य करता है?
oe: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
oh: उपभोक्ता मामले, खाद्य और सार्वजनिक वितरण मंत्रालय
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) is an attached office of the Department of Pharmaceuticals under the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers. It extended ceiling prices for orthopaedic knee implants until January 15, 2027, under the Drugs (Prices Control) Order (DPCO).
• Option A is Incorrect because the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare regulates drug approval and health standards through the CDSCO, not national price control.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ministry of Commerce and Industry handles foreign trade and industrial growth rather than drug pricing.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Ministry of Consumer Affairs monitors basic food commodity pricing, not pharmaceutical price regulation.

bihar_questions.qe: The Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA), an autonomous think-tank for corporate governance and public policy research, functions under which Union Ministry?
bihar_questions.qh: कॉर्पोरेट प्रशासन और लोक नीति अनुसंधान के लिए स्वायत्त संस्थान, भारतीय कॉर्पोरेट कार्य संस्थान (IICA), किस केंद्रीय मंत्रालय के अंतर्गत कार्य करता है?
oe: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA) is an autonomous institution established under the administrative oversight of the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Ministry of Finance deals with fiscal policy, banking, and revenue, not IICA administration.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Ministry of Skill Development manages national vocational skill programs.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Ministry of Commerce and Industry regulates trade policy and domestic industry facilitation.

bihar_questions.qe: Where is the ICAR-Central Inland Fisheries Research Institute (CIFRI) headquartered?
bihar_questions.qh: भाकृअनुप-केंद्रीय अंतर्देशीय मत्स्य अनुसंधान संस्थान (ICAR-CIFRI) का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the ICAR-Central Inland Fisheries Research Institute (CIFRI) is headquartered at Barrackpore, West Bengal.
• Option B is Incorrect because Cuttack hosts the ICAR-National Rice Research Institute (NRRI).
• Option C is Incorrect because Kochi hosts the ICAR-Central Marine Fisheries Research Institute (CMFRI).
• Option D is Incorrect because Patna hosts the ICAR Research Complex for Eastern Region (ICAR-RCER).

bihar_questions.qe: Under which Indian Railway zone was 100% electrification of 4,311.96 route kilometres achieved?
bihar_questions.qh: कौन से भारतीय रेलवे ज़ोन ने 4,311.96 किलोमीटर के मार्ग पर 100% विद्युतिकरण पूरा किया?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR) announced completion of 100% electrification across its jurisdiction covering 4,311.96 RKM.
• Option B is Incorrect because Eastern Railway operates in a different region and was not mentioned in the electrification announcement.
• Option C is Incorrect because Northern Railway’s network lies in northern India, not the North‑East.
• Option D is Incorrect because South Eastern Railway does not cover the North‑East zone.

bihar_questions.qe: What is the total expenditure incurred by the Namami Gange programme over its first decade?
bihar_questions.qh: नमामी गंगा कार्यक्रम ने अपने पहले दशक में कुल कितना खर्च किया है?
bihar_questions.e:

• Option A is Incorrect as the figure is lower than the actual reported outlay.
• Option C is Incorrect because it exceeds the documented expenditure.
• Option D is Incorrect; the amount is far below the programme’s budget.

bihar_questions.qe: Which new high‑speed train service has been proposed to enhance connectivity between Sitamarhi and Ayodhya in Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: सितामढ़ी और अयोध्या के बीच कनेक्टिविटी बढ़ाने के लिए प्रस्तावित नया हाई‑स्पीड ट्रेन सेवा कौन सी है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because railway officials have proposed a Vande Bharat Express between Sitamarhi and Ayodhya.
• Option A is Incorrect; Tejas Express operates on other corridors.
• Option B is Incorrect; Gatimaan Express runs on a different route.
• Option D is Incorrect; Shatabdi Express is not part of the proposed Sitamarhi‑Ayodhya link.

bihar_questions.qe: Under which central scheme is RailTel implementing hybrid Smart Classrooms and ICT Labs in Bihar colleges?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार के कॉलेजों में हाइब्रिड स्मार्ट क्लासरूम और आईसीटी लैब्स लागू करने के लिए रेलटेल किस केंद्रीय योजना के तहत कार्य कर रहा है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the contract is executed under the Pradhan Mantri‑Uttam Shiksha Abhiyan (PM‑USHA) scheme.
• Option A is Incorrect; Digital India is a broader initiative but not the specific nodal scheme for this contract.
• Option B is Incorrect; Skill India focuses on vocational training, not classroom infrastructure.
• Option C is Incorrect; the National Education Policy provides guidelines but does not fund the specific project.

bihar_questions.qe: Which department of the Bihar government launched the 'Sankalp Sandhya' programme to provide free evening remedial classes for students of Classes 9 to 12?
bihar_questions.qh: कक्षा 9 से 12 तक के विद्यार्थियों को निःशुल्क सायं सुधारात्मक कक्षाएं प्रदान करने के लिए बिहार सरकार के किस विभाग ने 'संकल्प संध्या' कार्यक्रम शुरू किया है?
oe: Science, Technology and Technical Education Department
oh: विज्ञान, प्रौद्योगिकी एवं तकनीकी शिक्षा विभाग
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Bihar Education Department launched 'Sankalp Sandhya' to conduct free evening classes (5:00 pm to 7:30 pm) for academically weak students in Classes 9 to 12 across selected government schools in all 38 district headquarters until March 31, 2027.
• Option B is Incorrect because the initiative is directly administered by the Education Department, not the Social Welfare Department.
• Option C is Incorrect because it covers general government school students across all categories.
• Option D is Incorrect because technical education departments handle higher technical institutes, not high school remedial classes.

bihar_questions.qe: In which district of Bihar is the state's major operational dry port facility located at Bihta, for which expansion to other regions has recently been requested by the state government?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार का प्रमुख परिचालन सूखा बंदरगाह (ड्राय पोर्ट) बिहटा में स्थित है, जिसके विस्तार के लिए हाल ही में राज्य सरकार ने अनुरोध किया है, यह किस जिले में स्थित है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Bihta is located in Patna district, Bihar, where the state's primary dry port facility is situated.
• Option B is Incorrect because Gaya is being developed for an Integrated Manufacturing Cluster under the AKIC corridor, not the Bihta dry port.
• Option C is Incorrect because Muzaffarpur is a key commercial center in North Bihar but does not house the Bihta dry port.
• Option D is Incorrect because Darbhanga is prominent for its regional airport and logistics hub, not the Bihta facility.

bihar_questions.qe: In which district of Bihar is the 2,400 MW ultra-supercritical thermal power plant at Pirpainti being developed, for which a major power transmission project was recently awarded?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार के किस जिले में पीरपैंती 2,400 मेगावाट की अल्ट्रा-सुपरक्रिटिकल थर्मल पावर परियोजना विकसित की जा रही है, जिसके लिए हाल ही में एक प्रमुख बिजली पारेषण परियोजना आवंटित की गई है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Pirpainti is located in Bhagalpur district, Bihar, where a 2,400 MW ultra-supercritical thermal power plant is being setup with an associated transmission project.
• Option A is Incorrect because Buxar hosts the Chausa thermal power project being executed by SJVN.
• Option B is Incorrect because Kaimur is designated for wildlife and eco-tourism initiatives.
• Option D is Incorrect because Begusarai hosts the historic Barauni Thermal Power Station.

bihar_questions.qe: According to NITI Aayog's governance roadmap released under the 'Leadership as Mission' series, what sustained annual real GDP growth rate is required for India to reach a USD 30–40 trillion economy by 2047?
bihar_questions.qh: नीति आयोग की 'लीडरशिप एज मिशन' श्रृंखला के तहत जारी सुशासन रोडमैप के अनुसार, भारत को 2047 तक 30-40 ट्रिलियन अमेरिकी डॉलर की अर्थव्यवस्था बनाने के लिए कितनी निरंतर वार्षिक वास्तविक जीडीपी वृद्धि दर आवश्यक है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because NITI Aayog's workshop highlights that achieving a USD 30–40 trillion economy by 2047 mandates a sustained annual real GDP growth rate of 7–10%.
• Option A is Incorrect because 5–7% represents conventional baseline growth, insufficient for the 2047 target.
• Option B is Incorrect because 6–8% is India's present medium-term growth rate.
• Option C is Incorrect because 8–11% exceeds the specific projection calculated by NITI Aayog.

bihar_questions.qe: Which city won the first rank in the 'Digital Innovation' category among cities with a population under 1 million at the PM SVANidhi Samman Puraskar 2026?
bihar_questions.qh: पीएम स्वनिधि सम्मान पुरस्कार 2026 में 1 मिलियन से कम आबादी वाले शहरों की श्रेणी में 'डिजिटल इनोवेशन' में किस शहर ने पहला स्थान हासिल किया?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Durgapur (West Bengal) secured the first rank in the 'Digital Innovation' category among cities with a population under 1 million at the PM SVANidhi Samman Puraskar 2026, presented by the Union Minister of Housing and Urban Affairs.
• Option B is Incorrect because Cuttack did not secure the top position in the Digital Innovation category.
• Option C is Incorrect because Gaya did not win the top award in this category.
• Option D is Incorrect because Ranchi was not awarded the first rank in this category.

bihar_questions.qe: The newly inaugurated 9.76-km-long six-lane cable-stayed bridge named 'Nitish Setu' over the Ganga River connects which two places in Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: गंगा नदी पर नवनिर्मित 9.76 किलोमीटर लंबा छह लेन वाला केबल-स्टे्ड पुल 'नितीश सेतु' बिहार के किन दो स्थानों को जोड़ता है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the 9.76-km long six-lane cable-stayed bridge named 'Nitish Setu' is constructed over the Ganga River, connecting Kachchi Dargah in Patna district to Bidupur in Vaishali district.
• Option A is Incorrect because Mokama and Begusarai are connected via the Rajendra Setu / Aunta-Simaria bridge.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Sultanganj-Aguwani bridge connects Bhagalpur and Khagaria districts.
• Option D is Incorrect because Digha and Sonepur are connected via the Jayaprakash Setu.

bihar_questions.qe: In which state was India's first Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), which recently celebrated its Platinum Jubilee, established in 1951?
bihar_questions.qh: 1951 में स्थापित भारत का पहला भारतीय प्रौद्योगिकी संस्थान (IIT), जिसने हाल ही में अपनी प्लैटिनम जयंती मनाई, किस राज्य में स्थित है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: IIT Kharagpur, located in West Bengal, is India's first IIT (established in 1951). Prime Minister Narendra Modi participated in its Platinum Jubilee celebrations.
• Option B is Incorrect: Uttar Pradesh hosted the 5th Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh at Lucknow.
• Option C is Incorrect: Bihar was part of the multi-state development tour but not the site of the first IIT.
• Option D is Incorrect: IIT Bombay in Maharashtra was established later in 1958.

bihar_questions.qe: Which department is the nodal agency for the development of ropeway projects at 20 major tourist destinations in Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में 20 प्रमुख पर्यटन स्थलों पर रोपवे परियोजनाओं के विकास के लिए कौन सा विभाग मुख्य एजेंसी है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because ropeway infrastructure is classified under tourism development and the Bihar Tourism Department has been designated as the nodal agency for these projects.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Road Transport Department handles roadways, not aerial ropeway systems.
• Option C is Incorrect because urban development focuses on city planning, not tourism ropeways.

bihar_questions.qe: Under the new directive, who is required to taste and certify the Mid-Day Meal before distribution in Bihar schools?
